jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS Fault Injection Services
jobs.jd:
AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS) is a fully managed service for running fault injection and chaos engineering experiments on AWS. Customers use FIS to deliberately and safely stress their applications, uncover hidden weaknesses, validate that their monitoring and alarms work, and prove that their systems recover the way they expect, all before a real incident happens. FIS experiments apply controlled faults to targeted resources, guarded by stop conditions that automatically halt an experiment the moment it moves outside safe limits.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to own the design and delivery of the fault actions at the core of FIS. You will build the capabilities that safely disrupt production-grade AWS services, such as Amazon EC2, Amazon EKS and Kubernetes workloads, and Amazon ElastiCache, and you will drive the resilience, scalability, and safety of those systems. You will set the technical direction for your team's software, advise senior leadership on architecture and roadmap, and mentor engineers across the team.

Safety is central to this role. A fault that is too broad, or that fires against the wrong resource, can affect real customer workloads, so you will own the authorization, blast-radius controls, and operational rigor that let customers trust FIS to break their systems on purpose. If you enjoy distributed-systems problems where correctness and customer safety matter as much as scale, this is a rare place to work on them.

Key job responsibilities
Own the architecture for one or more FIS fault domains, providing a system-wide view and design guidance, and act as a key influencer on your team's technical strategy and goals.
Design, build, and release software at large scale for AWS customers worldwide, then operate it in production and keep it highly available and durable.
Build new fault actions and target types end to end: API design, authorization, execution logic, automated testing, and documentation, and safely evolve existing ones.
Identify high-impact, hard-to-reverse technical decisions early, and drive the team toward durable solutions rather than short-term workarounds, especially where customer safety and blast radius are at stake.
Raise the operational bar for your team: strong alarms and telemetry, clear runbooks, effective guardrails, and a healthy culture of incident review and continuous improvement.
Partner with the AWS service teams whose faults FIS supports to design integrations and land cross-team deliveries successfully.
Advise your management and senior leadership on technical trade-offs, and contribute to short- and long-term planning.
Actively mentor multiple engineers and champion engineering best practices that others adopt.

A day in the life
A Senior SDE on FIS is an owner of the product, not just of individual components. A typical day combines hands-on building with work that makes the whole team more effective: producing and reviewing designs for complex fault-domain problems, building and operating fault actions across the service, reasoning carefully about authorization and blast radius so an action can never exceed its intended scope, keeping a close watch on operational health, and unblocking and mentoring the engineers around you.

You will join AWS Resilience, working on a service that thousands of AWS customers rely on to make their own systems more reliable.

 We are seeking a highly technical Senior Production Reliability Engineer to lead our local Excellence in Engineering team. This is not a software development role: its focus is the reliability, diagnosability and operational effectiveness of complex, largely non-cloud production systems . The successful candidate will combine deep knowledge of system architecture, data flows and databases with advanced debugging, monitoring and troubleshooting skills. They will lead difficult investigations through to root cause, drive AI-enabled automation and operational improvement, and provide technical direction and mentoring to the local team. Infrastructure, capacity and performance are important supporting areas, but cloud-platform engineering is not the primary remit. 

 Key Responsibilities: 

 Advanced Incident Investigation & Problem Management 

- Lead complex, high-impact and multi-system production investigations from triage and containment through recovery, root cause and corrective action. 

- Diagnose issues across applications, services, operating systems, databases, messaging and networks using logs, traces, metrics, configuration, queries and controlled reproduction. 

- Retain end-to-end ownership while coordinating effectively with software engineering, product, infrastructure and customer-facing teams.

SENIOR ENGINEER - PLATFORM

The role and its impact

As a Senior Engineer in our Infrastructure team, you’ll help Xero engineers build and test software faster and with more confidence. You’ll design and build the systems that create test environments, and you’ll make sure test data is ready when teams need it. This work sits at the heart of how we ship software, and it helps set Xero up for AI transformation.

You’ll work across complex platforms, including older legacy systems alongside modern technology. There will be trade-offs to weigh as you decide where the most value sits for engineering teams. Xero asks you to Go Bold in how you approach these problems, and to Go Fast without cutting corners.

The team and how they connect

Our Infrastructure team builds the platform foundations that Xero engineers rely on every day. Our engineers come from software, platform and infrastructure backgrounds, and we work closely with teams across Xero to understand their systems and find elegant solutions. We believe in Going Together, which means sharing knowledge openly and making sure everyone’s voice is heard.

The team is currently working on / Initially, you will focus on:

 - Building support systems and tooling for test environments, so engineers can test changes without waiting on blockers.

 - Improving test data and enabling frictionless testing across engineering teams.

 - Working with our Golang services, alongside infrastructure built with Terraform on AWS, including Kubernetes, EC2 and Lambda.

 - Contributing to a longer-running initiative to shorten feedback loops and increase engineering productivity.

Where and how you can work

This is a permanent role, based in Melbourne, Sydney or Brisbane with a remote-first working culture. We have no set office days, so you’ll work with your manager and team to find a balance that suits how you do your best work. Once you’ve settled in, you’ll join our on-call rotation as part of supporting the systems we build.

Here are some of the things we’re looking for, for this role:

 - Your background could be in software engineering that has moved into platform or DevOps, or in infrastructure work that understands how software is built.

 - Golang is our preferred language, though strong experience in Java or .NET is equally welcome.

 - Hands-on experience with Terraform, AWS and Kubernetes will help you hit the ground running.

 - A curious, problem-solving mindset and the ability to pick up unfamiliar systems quickly, including legacy ones, are key to how you’ll Go Further here.

 - Clear communication is second nature to you, whether you’re working in another team’s codebase or presenting to leadership.

Apply even if your experience isn’t a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

jobs.title: SDE II, EC2 Instance Networking, EC2 Nitro
jobs.jd:
Do you want to build the networking infrastructure that powers every virtual machine in the world's largest cloud? Are you excited by the challenge of writing systems software that runs on millions custom networking cards across millions of hosts?

The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) Instance Networking team builds and operates the software-defined networking stack at the heart of AWS. Our code is what makes Virtual Private Clouds (VPC) work, what enforces customer security policies, and what enables workloads to scale from a single instance to clusters of tens of thousands. Every packet that enters or leaves an EC2 instance flows through software we write, running on custom silicon designed in-house. 

This work sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and the AI revolution. As machine learning workloads grow to unprecedented scale - training runs spanning thousands of accelerators, clusters demanding millions of network endpoints, and fabrics pushing hundreds of gigabits per second. We build the networking primitives that make these workloads possible: high-performance interfaces, low-latency data plane protocols, and scalable network virtualization that operates predictably even under heavy churn. When the world's most ambitious AI companies scale on AWS, they're relying on the software we build.

You'll write low-level systems code in C and Rust running on custom hardware in a real-time 
embedded environment. You'll work on network virtualization protocols, packet processing pipelines, and availability mechanisms that must perform correctly at massive scale with sub-second latency requirements. You'll solve problems that span hardware, firmware, and 
software, and see the direct impact of your work on customers running some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the cloud.

Own the design, development, and delivery of data plane networking features for EC2 instances running on custom Nitro hardware
Drive operational excellence for network virtualization systems serving millions of AWS customers worldwide
Ensure the reliability, performance, and security of VPC connectivity and policy enforcement at scale
Lead technical investigations into complex production issues across distributed embedded systems, delivering root cause analysis and long-term fixes
Contribute to the technical roadmap for EC2 Instance Networking, identifying opportunities to improve performance, scalability, and customer experience
Partner with cross-functional teams — including hardware, control plane, and ML platform teams — to define and deliver end-to-end solutions
Raise the bar on engineering quality through code reviews, design reviews, and operational best practices

Write low-level systems code in C and Rust running on custom hardware in a real-time embedded environment

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you’ll work closely with product teams in Spend to deliver and maintain scalable, reliable cloud infrastructure for key product initiatives. jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Payments Products & Platform
jobs.location: AU: Sydney (45 Clarence St) | AU: Melbourne: (260 Burwood Rd) | Sydney, Australia
jobs.jd:
THE ROLE

 

Xero reimagined accounting software. Now we’re reimagining how small businesses get paid and how money moves. We're making a critical, multi-year investment in two connected engineering portfolios, Payments Products & Experiences and Payments Platform, and we're hiring a Principal Engineer for each. As our three-year payments strategy reaches a turning point, you'll help shape what comes next, with domain-level influence over the next two to three years.

 

You'll shape technical strategy across multiple teams, partnering with senior stakeholders to turn complex requirements into scalable, resilient systems. Staying close to the technical detail, you'll set the example for a portfolio of 40 to 50 engineers. You'll also join a global community of Principal Engineers across Xero, driving engineering standards, architecture, and best practices.

 

You'll Go Bold by setting long-term direction, and Go Together by bringing product, engineering and senior stakeholders with you.

 


THE TEAMS

Payments Products & Experiences: this portfolio is made up of our Get Paid and Growth teams, builds the checkout, payment methods, flexible payments and AI payment agents that help small businesses get paid on time. 

 

Payments Platform: this portfolio is the engine underneath, with provider integrations, bill payments and a single, product-agnostic API that other Xero teams build on. 

 

Together they move billions of dollars across more than 150,000 transactions a day, a number set to double as we grow into the UK and US.

 


THE TEAMS ARE CURRENTLY WORKING ON

 - Tech stack: microservices across web, API and data layers, built in languages such as C#, Java, Go or C++, running on AWS with SQL and NoSQL data stores.

 - Current focus: reviewing existing payments systems to work out what to extend, migrate or rebuild, alongside Growth experiments and AI-powered payment chasing.

 - Future focus: a multi-year payments architecture covering agentic payment workflows, payments inside AI assistants and recurring payments.

 - Global scale: replatforming payment methods and designing global rails and a ledger ready for new markets.
   
    


WHERE AND HOW YOU CAN WORK

You'll be based in Sydney or Melbourne, working a hybrid model that blends time together in our modern offices with the flexibility of working from home. Boost days bring teams together to connect and collaborate in person. With colleagues across Australia and the US and payment flows that run around the clock, you'll also work across time zones.

 


SOME OF THE THINGS WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You bring deep experience designing and running large-scale distributed systems in production, balancing reliability, performance and cost, and any payments or fintech experience is a real plus.

 - API-first thinking is second nature, and you're at home across web, API and data layers, with fluency in at least one modern backend language, SQL and NoSQL stores, and cloud-native platforms, ideally AWS.

 - Legacy-heavy systems are a puzzle you enjoy, and you make clear, practical calls on whether to extend, migrate or build while staying hands-on through pairing, spikes and code.

 - A strong interest in utilising AI tooling is essential, as you will model how to use these technologies to automate tasks and improve engineering outcomes.

 - Your background shows a deep curiosity for growth hacking and a proven ability to design and analyse A/B tests that drive product usage.

 - You'll Go Further by mentoring Staff and Senior engineers, shaping cross-team initiatives with Xero's Principal community and setting standards that lift engineering across Xero.
   
    

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for an exceptional senior software development engineer to create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

jobs.jd:
This is Adyen 

 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 

 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 

 Senior Linux System Engineer 

 You will join a multidisciplinary Infrastructure Engineering team that owns the core of Adyen's infrastructure: configuration management, mail infrastructure, and identity and access management. These components sit underneath everything we do. Every engineer, system, and service at Adyen depends on them working reliably and securely.

 We are looking for a Senior Linux Engineer with a strong background in identity and access management and security principles, who can strengthen the team and help us keep our infrastructure secure. Zero trust, just-in-time and just-enough access, and clear access policies are central to how we work. Our IAM landscape covers humans, systems, and increasingly AI agents, across on-premise and cloud environments, from small clusters to some of our largest platforms.

 If you are an experienced Linux engineer who thinks like an attacker, cares about getting access right, and enjoys owning critical systems in production, this role is for you.

 What You'll Do 

 Your main focus is the identity and access management layer of our infrastructure. You will make sure every person, system, and agent gets exactly the access they need, only when they need it, and that every access decision can be explained and audited.

- Identity & Access Management: Maintain and improve our IAM infrastructure for humans, systems, and AI agents across on-premise and cloud environments, using tools such as Teleport and SPIFFE/SPIRE.

- Zero Trust & Access Policies: Work with zero trust, just-in-time, and just-enough access principles across the infrastructure. Define, refine, and enforce the access policies and models behind them.

- Security & Compliance: Work closely with Security and Compliance teams on access reviews, audits, and hardening, and turn findings into concrete improvements.

- Core Infrastructure: Alongside IAM, support and maintain our other core infrastructure components, including LDAP, Puppet, Ansible, and our mail infrastructure, and keep them stable, secure, and low-maintenance.

- Support & Reliability: Act as an escalation point for access and infrastructure issues, help teams resolve and learn from incidents, and take part in a blameless on-call rotation.

- Collaborate & Upskill: Share your IAM and security knowledge within a multidisciplinary team and across the wider engineering organization.

 What We're Looking For 

 Minimum Requirements: 

- 8+ years of hands-on Linux systems engineering in large-scale, high-availability production environments.

- A strong background in identity and access management, with a solid grasp of security principles such as zero trust, least privilege, and just-in-time and just-enough access, and experience turning them into enforceable access policies.

- Hands-on experience operating production services on Kubernetes, identity and access tooling such as Teleport, SPIFFE/SPIRE, HashiCorp Vault, or equivalents, and a good understanding of PKI, short-lived certificates, and mTLS.

- Deep knowledge of LDAP and the Linux authentication stack, including SSSD, PAM, and SSH, as well as identity protocols such as OIDC, OAuth 2.0, and SAML.

- Experience with configuration management at scale (Puppet, Ansible) and with scripting or programming in Bash, Python, or Go.

- Clear communication skills, and the ability to explain access and security decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

 Highly Desired Skills: 

- Experience with IAM in a regulated environment such as financial services (PCI DSS, DORA).

- Experience with Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) systems. 

- Familiarity with policy-as-code tools such as OPA, Cedar, RBAC.

 Who you are 

 You are security-minded and think about how something can be abused before it ships. You prefer simple, reliable solutions over clever ones, and you take ownership of problems until they are solved. You enjoy working in a team with mixed expertise, you share what you know, and you keep learning as identity, security, and AI continue to evolve.

 Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Adyen 

 We actively seek different perspectives to sharpen our ideas. Our unique culture is a product of our diverse backgrounds and experiences. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome to be your true self at Adyen. 

 If you need accommodations or support during the recruitment process to perform at your best, you’ll have the opportunity to let our team know in your application. We encourage people from all backgrounds and abilities to apply. 

 What’s next? 

 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 

 This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

- You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

- You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.

- You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, and Kubernetes.

- Experience scaling relevant technologies such as Iceberg, Flink, Airflow, Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, and Terraform.

- You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.

- You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.

- Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.

- You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

- This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

 This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

- Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

- Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

- Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

- Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

jobs.location: Remote - Canada: Select locations | Canada | Ireland | US
jobs.jd:
Role Description 

 As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox’s Windows endpoint platform. You will bring deep Windows and Intune expertise, make patching and application delivery more reliable, and build automation that reduces recurring work for the team.

 This is a hands-on role combining Windows technical ownership with the development of a more code-managed endpoint platform. You will help evaluate and adopt FleetDM, osquery, infrastructure-as-code, and GitOps practices where they improve reliability, visibility, and maintainability. You will strengthen the current environment while building and validating the path forward—not assume that replacing a tool is the answer.

 You will work with CorpInfra, IAM, Security, and support teams to make practical technical decisions, lead multi-phase improvements, and clarify ownership. You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position.

 Responsibilities 

- Own endpoint reliability and lifecycle management. Improve provisioning, application delivery, updates, security configuration, and troubleshooting across the endpoint environment. 

- Make patching predictable and safe. Strengthen update workflows through testing, controlled rollouts, and remediation. 

- Make fleet health trustworthy and actionable. Improve reporting on device health, patching, and configuration, with clear ownership for resolving issues. 

- Build maintainable automation. Turn recurring work into reliable, tested workflows that other engineers can operate. 

- Advance code-managed endpoint operations. Adopt tools and practices that improve configuration management, validation, and deployment. 

- Lead cross-functional platform improvements. Define practical roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and balance security, reliability, employee experience, and team capacity. 

- Strengthen the team’s capability. Mentor teammates, review code and designs, and document reusable practices that improve coverage across the endpoint team. 

 Requirements 

- Significant experience engineering and operating Windows endpoint environments, with personal ownership beyond ticket handling or routine console administration. 

- Deep hands-on Intune experience across device lifecycle, configuration and compliance policies, application management, update workflows, and relevant Entra ID dependencies. 

- Strong Windows troubleshooting skills across operating-system behavior, services, logs, networking, certificates, identity, and security controls. Able to distinguish reported management status from actual endpoint health. 

- Recent ownership of Windows and third-party application patching, including staged deployment, user-impact validation, failed-device handling, exceptions, and recovery. 

- Strong practical PowerShell skills and familiarity with at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Go, or C#. Experience building and maintaining production automation or systems integrations. 

- Demonstrated use of version control, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for operational changes. Able to explain safe retries, failure handling, secrets management, and configuration drift. 

- Ability to independently define and deliver multi-phase work, prioritize under ambiguity, partner across teams, and mentor other engineers. 

- Clear written and verbal communication, including concise technical decisions, incident updates, runbooks, and effective asynchronous collaboration. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Production experience with FleetDM on Windows , including agent operations, policies, queries, targeting, API integrations, or configuration managed through GitOps. 

- Practical osquery and SQL experience for endpoint inventory, health, or security use cases, including query validation, performance considerations, and handling stale or missing results. 

- Experience with infrastructure-as-code or declarative configuration, continuous integration and delivery, and migration or coexistence between endpoint-management platforms. 

- Experience with Automox, Patch My PC, or comparable tools , and with endpoint privilege management, application control, encryption, or other security controls. 

- Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments and contributing reusable automation across Windows, macOS, or Linux. 

 Durable Skills 

 AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: 

- Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others . 

- Judgment: E valuat e information and mak e decisions in complex situations . 

- Adaptability: L earn, adjust, and stay effective through change . 

- Connection: C ommunicat e , collaborat e , and build trust . 

 To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser. 

 Compensation 
 Canada Pay Range
 $125,000 — $170,000 CAD

The role / impact

You will deliver high-quality, impactful software that aligns with team and business goals, always keeping customer needs and outcomes front of mind. By identifying and solving complex, ambiguous problems independently, you will produce robust, high-quality, and scalable software that helps change the world by supporting small businesses. Your daily work will focus on systems, scalability, and engineering quality while collaborating across teams to drive technical excellence and developer efficiency.

Through clear and thoughtful communication, you will ensure stakeholders are well-informed and aligned. You will play a key part in fostering an inclusive team culture by mentoring others and sharing feedback with empathy. Your active participation in planning, delivery, and continuous improvement will contribute directly to the success of the broader Xero community.

The team / how they connect

You will join the Payments team within Product Platforms, which forms the critical foundation underneath core product areas like invoices, bills, payments, and payroll. The team exists to make it easy for other groups across Xero to build on a strong foundation of accounting concepts, data, and libraries safely and efficiently. Operating across Wellington and Vancouver, we collaborate closely to reduce tight coupling, establish clear service boundaries, and accelerate product velocity global-wide.

The team is currently working on / Initially, you will focus on

 - Transitioning from a monolithic architecture to modern microservices to remove delivery bottlenecks and improve efficiency.

 - Building and operating services in a production cloud environment utilizing C#, .NET Core, and AWS.

 - Resolving complex legacy problems, database scalability challenges, and modernizing service interfaces or APIs.

jobs.jd:
Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.
- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.
- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.
- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.
- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.
- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.
- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

jobs.jd:
As a Software Engineer III in Asset & Wealth Management – Data & Analytics at JPMorgan Chase, you will help build the instrument reference data platform that many teams rely on. You will write Java services that collect, enrich and share this data. We are now opening the platform to users in the US, EMEA and APAC, and building AI and automation tools for our engineers. If you enjoy hard problems in a growing cloud environment and want to shape what comes next, join us.
 
 Job Responsibilities 
 
- Design and deliver core Java and Spring Boot services and APIs (REST and GraphQL), and the event (Kafka, MQ), streaming and bulk paths that distribute instrument data to consumers, owning each service from design through production stability

- Tackle complex technical problems and think beyond conventional approaches to build scalable, resilient solutions

- Find root causes of data and production issues by tracing instrument data across ingestion, enrichment, storage and downstream distribution, and fix the causes, not the symptom

- Develop, debug and maintain production code, business rules (Drools) and database changes in a large enterprise environment

- Uphold engineering excellence through thorough code reviews, automated and BDD testing, quality gates, and timely framework and security-vulnerability upgrades

- Produce architecture and design artifacts for complex applications and make sure design constraints are met in code

- Mentor engineers and contribute reusable patterns and tooling back to the group

- Build and improve automation and AI-based tooling that raises engineering leverage across the team

- Use enterprise-authorized AI coding-assist tools (code generation and refactoring, test creation, documentation) to improve quality, speed and productivity, validating outputs through peer review, automated testing and secure coding standards

- Work with engineering and product teams to deliver platform capabilities that support global investment operations at scale

 Required qualifications, capabilities, and skill 
 
- Formal training or certification in software engineering concepts and advanced applied experience

- Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot (Java 17 or later), designing, developing, testing, debugging and maintaining production services in a large enterprise environment

- Experience distributing and consuming data using event and Kafka streaming, APIs (GraphQL and REST) and bulk methods and experience with relational (SQL) databases and at least one NoSQL store

- Hands-on experience in system design, application development, testing and operational stability, including production support

- Solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle, agile delivery, CI/CD, application resiliency and security with hands-on experience with enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development tools, and the ability to critically evaluate, validate and refine AI-generated output for correctness, performance and security

- Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows (data sensitivity, secure handling of inputs and outputs, resiliency and security expectations), and the ability to guide peers on safe and effective use

 Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills 
 
- Knowledge of data mesh distribution patterns using Snowflake and Starburst [CONFIRM: keep as preferred]

- Experience building on AWS services (compute, storage, messaging and access management), and experience with infrastructure as code such as Terraform 

- Experience with a rules engine (for example Drools), Spring Batch, Liquibase and Cucumber (BDD)

- Knowledge of financial instrument reference data (identifiers such as ISIN, CUSIP and SEDOL, asset classes, security master concepts)

- Knowledge of Python

- Interest or experience in AI, agentic tooling or developer-automation platforms

jobs.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.location: BENGALURU, KARNATAKA, India | HYDERABAD, TELANGANA, India
jobs.jd:
Designs and architects infrastructure and service to ensure reliability and functionality. Forecasts demands and responds to capacity needs. Collaborates with software development teams to develop reliable and scalable infrastructures. Exercises judgment when performing data collection to maintain and optimize operations and reliability. Leverages advanced knowledge to perform incident response and/or maintenance tasks. Provides comprehensive health and performance reporting. Identifies and recommends opportunities for automation. Communicates comprehensive information about services and proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of changes. Provides comprehensive support for technology and documents incidents. Conducts advanced experiments with new tools and develops and maintains advanced knowledge of site reliability trends.

Mandatory 
 
- 5+ years of hands-on experience across software development, site reliability engineering, monitoring, and automation, with demonstrated ownership of production platforms.

- Strong programming skills in Python and experience developing backend services, REST APIs, integrations, and event-driven workflows.

- Proven experience building monitoring and observability solutions that collect and analyze alerts, metrics, logs, and service context.

- Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into applications for incident analysis, contextual recommendations, and operational decision support.

- Ability to develop reusable agents that combine live monitoring data, historical incidents, and previous remediation actions to recommend next steps.

- Experience implementing alert correlation, deduplication, enrichment, and prioritization to reduce noise and improve incident detection.

- Strong experience developing automated remediation workflows with approval controls, execution validation, audit trails, and recovery safeguards.

- Experience integrating monitoring platforms with incident management systems, knowledge repositories, and notification or escalation services.

- Strong understanding of distributed systems, Linux, networking, databases, and application performance, with the ability to translate failure patterns into platform capabilities.

- Experience applying software engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, version control, and secure development.

- Ability to evaluate platform reliability and AI output quality, measure operational outcomes, and improve capabilities using engineer feedback.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with monitoring teams, service owners, and engineers to onboard services and define requirements.
 Good-to-Have 
 
- Experience with agentic AI frameworks, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, and vector databases.

- Knowledge of anomaly detection, time-series analysis, and predictive techniques for identifying recurring alarm patterns.

- Experience building centralized notification services, automated escalation calls, and incident communication workflows.

- Familiarity with OCI, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.

- Experience with observability platforms such as OCI Observability, Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent tools.

- Exposure to Oracle Database and Exadata monitoring, performance diagnostics, and remediation automation.

- Experience using AI coding assistants to improve operational scripts and validate proposed changes.

- Knowledge of SLOs, error budgets, and incident metrics such as detection time, recovery time, and recurrence rate.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Capacity Ingestion and Management: 
 - Designs and architects infrastructure and/or service according to terms for reliability and functionality. 
 - Forecasts demands for infrastructure and responds to capacity needs, ensuring systems have sufficient resources to handle current and future workloads and identifying resource gaps. 
 - Collaborates with the software development team to develop infrastructures, ensuring features are reliable and scalable according to deployment requirements. 
 - Proactively identifies opportunities for prototyping and drives prototyping initiatives (e.g., testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding) to explore novel approaches. 
 Incident and Service Lifecycle Management: 
 - Exercises judgment when performing data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection to maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability. 
 - Takes proactive steps to monitor services, maintain up-to-date knowledge of their performance, and document their condition. 
 - Leverages advanced knowledge to perform incident response, root cause analyses, and/or maintenance on assigned services (e.g., software installs, version upgrades, security updates, backup and recovery). 
 - Provides comprehensive health and performance reporting and takes appropriate actions based on trends in data. 
 - May perform provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services. 
 - May experiment with new approaches for and performs decommissioning (e.g., shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed. 
 Automation: 
 - Identifies and recommends opportunities for automation and assesses potential benefits to enhance operational efficiency. 
 - Develops and implements design, automation tools, or scripts to provide solutions, gather metrics, monitor, analyze, mitigate, or remediate issues/defects within infrastructures. 
 - Conducts testing on moderately complex automations to ensure they perform tasks correctly and produce expected results. 
 Technical Communication and Guidance: 
 - Writes release notes and/or communicates comprehensive information about the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of services and technology with customers and immediate and related teams. 
 - Proactive

jobs.jd:
The Role 
 We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This role sits where large language models meet distributed systems. You'll apply machine learning, LLM, and distributed systems expertise to make agents plan, reason, and use tools reliably, and you'll build the production systems that run those agents at enterprise scale.

Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own.

 What you get to do in this role: 
 
- Agent orchestration engine — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations

- Model routing and adaptation — Choose, route between, and fine-tune or distill LLMs for specific agent tasks. Meet enterprise requirements such as granular permissions, data freshness, explainability, and preserving general knowledge.

- Distributed session management — Lease-based ownership using conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing

- Event-driven message pipeline — FIFO queues for ordered delivery, consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO 

- Structured concurrency — Running multiple concurrent tasks per session with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation

- Observability infrastructure — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes

- Caching and state layers — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration

- Tool and agent connectivity for LLMs: Build MCP and agent-to-agent (A2A) capabilities, including tool discovery, namespacing, and tool selection over large tool catalogs, so the LLM picks and calls the right tool from thousands of candidates.

- Token efficiency and context engineering — Lower the agent's cost and latency through prompt and context discipline, caching, speculative and parallel model-call scheduling, and reducing tokens spent across multi-step LLM reasoning chains.

- Open-weights model adoption and evaluation — Quickly stand up newly released open-weights LLMs at different quantization levels, run them in a test environment, and benchmark their accuracy, latency and cost on agent tasks. Use the results to decide which models reach production.

To be successful in this role you have: 
 You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas: 
 
- Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing

- Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling

- Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees

- Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub)

- Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics

- gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns

- Machine learning: Large language models, natural language processing, LLM evaluation

 Required:

- Strong in Python or Go (ideally both)

- Experience designing and operating systems that handle real traffic at scale

- Hands-on experience building production systems that use LLMs or other ML models

- Comfort with ambiguity — these are novel problems without textbook solutions

 MongoDB is growing its team in Sydney, focusing on building intelligent tools that help customers understand and modernise their application codebases. The Application Modernisation Platform (AMP) guides customers through the entire journey of modernising their applications — from legacy relational platforms to modern, scalable systems built on MongoDB. The App Analysis & Modelling team owns the critical first stage of this journey: building the context that powers everything downstream. The team builds code analysis tools that construct code dependency graphs and generate deep insights for codebases, giving customers a clear understanding of their existing applications before transformation begins. The team also designs schema recommendation engines that analyse signals such as existing relational schemas and query patterns to inform data modelling decisions. Our work sits at the intersection of analysis, data modelling, and AI — helping developers make confident, data-driven decisions as they transition to MongoDB.

 We are looking for a Software Engineer who is passionate about building scalable backend systems and applications. As we expand our use of AI to power smarter analysis and recommendations, the ideal candidate will bring strong backend engineering fundamentals with the ability to contribute across the full stack. You will collaborate closely with product management and other engineering teams to design and deliver cutting-edge features that guide customers through complex modernisation journeys.

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Sydney for our hybrid working model.

The Ideal Candidate Will Have

- 3-5+ years (Mid-Level) or 5+ years (Senior) of commercial software development experience with strong proficiency in Python and/or Java

- Experience(or extensive experience for senior candidates) designing and building scalable, high-performance APIs and backend services

- Solid understanding of relational data modelling and SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar), including schema design and query optimisation

- Good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and their time and space complexity

- Experience with frontend development using React and TypeScript, or a demonstrated willingness and ability to work across the full stack

- Degree in Computer Science or a similar field, or equivalent practical experience

- Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Nice to Have

- Experience building AI-powered features, including working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic workflows

- Experience with code analysis, static analysis tooling, or building tools that traverse and interpret code structures programmatically

- Familiarity with MongoDB

- Experience with cloud-native distributed systems (e.g., Kubernetes or similar)

- Contributions to open-source projects

Position Expectations

- Contribute high-quality, well-tested code to the App Analysis & Modelling team’s backend and frontend services

- Design and build scalable APIs and data pipelines that power code analysis and schema recommendation features

- Drive technical design and architecture for complex features (for senior candidates), or deliver robust implementations following established designs (for mid-level candidates)

- Collaborate effectively with Product Management, other engineers, and designers to build and deliver on the product roadmap

- Participate actively in code reviews to enforce best practices and maintain a high bar for code quality

- Give and solicit feedback on technical design documents and pull requests

- Help troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the stack

- Perform tasks related to engineering process such as CI/CD, quality, and testing

- Mentor and guide team members while elevating engineering best practices (for senior candidates)

Success Measures

 Within the first three months, you will have:

- Familiarised yourself with the MongoDB database and aggregation language

- Familiarised yourself with the backend tech stack including Python, Java, and our API infrastructure

- Set up your software development environment and begin contributing to the codebase

- Started collaborating with your peers and contributed to code reviews and design discussions

 Within six months, you will have:

- Familiarised yourself with the full stack including the React/TypeScript frontend

- Worked on and delivered a large-scale feature in the product

- Contributed to and helped deliver multiple product releases

- Reviewed and contributed to scope and technical design documents

 Within twelve months, you will have:

- Become a core technical leader (for senior candidates) or an independent owner of complex features (for mid-level candidates)

- Delivered at least one large-scale feature that spans the entire tech stack

- Helped recruit and interview new members of the team

- Collaborated effectively with other teams at MongoDB on cross-functional projects

- Help recruit, mentor, and interview new members of the team (emphasized for senior candidates)

About MongoDB

 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon FinAuto - Travel & Events
jobs.jd:
The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.

We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization.

As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations.

You will contribute to a three-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile-first travel booking and Meetings & Events hub experiences across 45+ countries with real-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners. 

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.
- Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
- Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions.
- Coach teammates through code reviews and design discussions, raising the quality bar for the team's software and establishing shared engineering best practices.
- Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving system reliability and maintainability.

About the team
The Amazon Travel and Events Tech team sits within Finance Automation and is on a multi-year mission to unify how Amazon employees plan, book, pay for, and expense business travel and events worldwide. We are a collaborative, inclusive group of engineers, product managers, and scientists who value clear thinking and pragmatic design. If you want to build products at global scale that make a tangible difference in how people work, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

Preferred qualifications:
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.jd:
Role Overview: 
 
 Citi’s Banking Technology organization is seeking a highly hands-on Lead Software Engineer to design, build, and deploy cutting‑edge AI solutions for Investment, Corporate, and Commercial Banking.
 
 This role focuses on implementing scalable, agentic AI frameworks and generative AI solutions within small, agile squads. The successful candidate will operate with an AI‑first mindset , emphasizing rapid prototyping, MVP‑driven development, and iterative delivery of production‑grade AI capabilities.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 
- AI Solution Development: Design, implement, and deploy scalable agentic AI frameworks and generative AI solutions for critical business use cases, ensuring robustness, performance, security, and reliability.

- Agentic Systems: Develop and integrate agentic AI systems leveraging multiple model providers and platforms (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google APIs).

- Full‑Stack AI Engineering: Build full‑stack applications integrating LLM‑driven workflows and AI coding tools (e.g., Devin, GitHub Copilot).

- Iterative Delivery: Drive an MVP‑first, rapid‑iteration approach with continuous experimentation and improvement.

- Evaluation & Optimization: Define and implement metrics, evaluation strategies, and feedback loops to continuously improve AI system performance and behavior.

- Emerging Technologies: Research, prototype, and integrate advances in agent‑based, autonomous, and generative AI technologies.

- Technical Collaboration: Contribute hands‑on within cross‑functional teams and provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.

- Domain Alignment: Ensure AI solutions are well‑aligned to banking and financial services requirements, constraints, and business outcomes.

 Qualifications: 
 
- Programming: Strong proficiency in Python and/or Java (Spring Boot); working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript (Angular, Node.js). Full‑stack experience is a plus.

 AI/ML Expertise: 
 
- Solid understanding of core AI concepts such as knowledge representation, planning, and multi‑agent systems.

- Hands‑on experience with LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, MCPs, and agent frameworks (e.g., Google ADK).

- Practical experience with ML frameworks and libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit‑learn, NumPy, Pandas).

- Familiarity with AI coding tools such as Devin, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Antigravity.

- Software Engineering: Strong grounding in modern engineering practices including Git, CI/CD, testing, code reviews, agile delivery, application resiliency, and security.

- Architecture: Experience designing API‑first, microservices‑based and event‑driven architectures, including data engineering patterns for AI systems.

- Platforms: Hands‑on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.

- Problem Solving & Communication: Strong analytical skills with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts.

- Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of banking/financial services and regulated environments.

- Nice to Have: Experience in data science (statistical modeling, experimentation) and interest in mentoring junior AI engineers.

 Experience: 
 
- 6–10 years of progressive software engineering experience with a strong hands‑on coding background.

- 2+ years focused on AI software development, LLM‑based solutions, agentic systems, and/or machine learning.

- Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise‑scale AI capabilities into production.

 Education: 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Robotics, or a related quantitative discipline.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer (AVP)
jobs.jd:
Discover your future at Citi 
 Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

 Job Overview 
 Engineer the future of global finance. At Citi, our Tech team doesn’t just support finance – we are helping to redefine it. Every day, $5 trillion crosses through our network. We do business in 180+ countries operating at a scale few can match. From deploying advanced AI to helping shape global markets, we build systems that matter. Look to join a team where your work helps influence economies, your ideas can drive innovation and outcomes, and your growth is backed by mentorship, continuous learning and flexibility with potential hybrid work opportunities. Help solve real-world challenges that touch millions and get the opportunity to build the future of finance with Citi Tech.

 In this role, you will help to build the new Securities Settlements Stock Record platform, which will scale for high trade volumes, improve real time and batch reporting timelines and reduce risk by enhancing data quality controls to avoid any reputational and financial impact to firm. 

 This role will work closely with technology and business leadership in NAM and EMEA region. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Full-Stack Architecture & Development 
 
- Backend & Microservices: Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, resilient microservices and RESTful APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and modern enterprise integration patterns.

- Frontend Engineering: Build responsive, accessible, and intuitive single-page applications (SPAs) and user interfaces using Angular / React.

- Database Design & Management: Model, optimize, and manage relational databases (Oracle), ensuring optimal query performance, indexing strategies, and data consistency.

- AI Assisted Development: Appropriately leverage available AI tools to accelerate all development activities.

- Engineering Standards: Ensure all software developed complies with Citi’s standards around code quality and test coverage.
 
 Cloud & Containerized DevOps 
 
- Containerization & Orchestration: Package, deploy, and manage containerized workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and container platforms such as OpenShift.

- CI/CD & Automation: Integrate code into automated CI/CD build and release pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Tekton, Harness), enforcing code quality, automated testing, and security scanning.
 
 Systems Analysis, Design & Leadership 
 
- Conduct feasibility studies, technical assessments, time/cost estimates, and IT planning to deliver technology solutions aligned with business strategy.

- Monitor and govern all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, system architecture, coding, unit/integration testing, and production rollout.

- Recommend and implement robust application security standards, role-based access controls (RBAC), and vulnerability remediations throughout the application lifecycle.

- Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and mentor junior engineers, fostering engineering best practices, code reviews, and technical documentation.

- Operate with high independence of judgment, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, product managers, and enterprise architecture teams.

- Proactively manage and assess risk, adhering strictly to firm policies, regulatory compliance, and governance frameworks.

 Qualifications and Skills: 
 
- Proven relevant experience in a full-stack development role.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in fast-paced, agile environments.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills.

- Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements

- Experience with software development using agentic AI driven workflows

- Strong hands-on experience with Java J2EE and Spring based technology stack.

- Must have Hands-on SQL, Oracle database

- Expertise in system design and microservices architecture.

- Experience with event-driven architecture and distributed systems.

- Experience with trunk-based development, feature flags, and progressive delivery strategies.

- Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.

- Experience conducting code reviews, vulnerability assessments, and secure coding.

- Familiarity with modern cloud-native technologies (OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker).

- Good to have hands-on experience on Kafka

- Good to have Apache Camel expertise
 
 Education: 
 
- Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
 
 This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

 What we’ll provide you 

 By joining Citi, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as:
 
- 27 days annual leave (plus bank holidays)

- A discretional annual performance related bonus

- Private Medical Care & Life Insurance

- Employee Assistance Program

- Pension Plan

- Paid Parental Leave

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user's checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we’re moving to wide events, with one context-rich event per request, improving the signal-to-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We’re also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI-assisted code is well instrumented by default.

 We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams.

 What You'll Do 

· You will own the architecture of Affirm’s telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200+ TB/day.
· You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers need during incidents.
· You will shape how observability fits into agentic development, so that AI coding agents and code review catch instrumentation gaps before code ships.
· You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
· You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
· You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
· You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, polcities, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

 What We Look For 

· You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
· You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Flink and Kubernetes.
· You have built or operated high-volume telemetry systems (metrics, logs, and/or traces) using technologies like OpenTelemetry, Kafka, and Terraform.
· You have a well-informed point of view on modern observability practices such as structured and wide events, sampling, cardinality management, and SLOs.
· You have driven adoption of a platform standard across many engineering teams, through both tooling and engagement.
· You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
· You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.
· Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.
· You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

 Pay Grade - P
Equity Grade - 7

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. 

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $181,000 - $241,000 

Location - Remote Canada
 This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan. 

 #LI Remote 
 
 Remote-first with flexibility built in 
 Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

 Benefits designed for you 
 Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

- Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

- Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

- Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

- Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.
