jobs.jd:
Senior Full Stack Engineer 
 
 Job Purpose: 
 We are seeking a talented and passionate Senior Full Stack Engineer to design, architect, and deliver next-generation, mission-critical web applications.
 In this role, you will play a pivotal part in engineering scalable, high-performance distributed systems with Java / Spring Boot on the back end and modern, responsive user experiences with React & TypeScript on the front end.
 As a senior technical contributor, you will drive architectural decisions, champion clean coding and DevOps best practices, and mentor engineers across the team. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges at global scale and want to see your code make a tangible impact, we would love to have you on our team.
 
 Job Background / Context: 
 
- Architect & Build: Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and deployment of resilient microservices and full-stack web applications.

- Modern Front-End Engineering: Build intuitive, accessible, and high-performance user interfaces using modern React, Redux, and TypeScript.

- Robust Back-End Services: Develop high-throughput RESTful APIs, event-driven pipelines, and data persistence layers with Spring Boot, Spring Data, and relational/NoSQL databases.

- Engineering Excellence: Champion code quality through automated testing, peer code reviews, CI/CD automation, and architectural discussions.

- Scale & Optimize: Profile and optimize applications for maximum speed, security, resilience, and horizontal scalability.

- Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Act as a subject matter expert (SME), collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and platform architects, and coach junior/mid-level engineers.

- Innovation: Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, libraries, and frameworks to keep our tech stack modern and efficient.
 
 Our Core Tech Stack 
 
- Back End: Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA / Hibernate, Reactive Spring

- Front End: React, TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+), Redux / Modern State Management, HTML5, CSS3 / Modern CSS Frameworks, Webpack / Vite, MicroFrontEnd

- Databases & Data Stores: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis

- DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD Pipelines (Jenkins / GitHub Actions / Tekton), AWS / Hybrid Cloud

- Build & Version Control: Git, Maven, Gradle, npm / yarn
 
 Qualifications 
 Core Experience 
 
- 7-9 years of professional software engineering experience delivering production-grade full-stack web applications.

- Strong proficiency in Java and extensive, hands-on experience with the Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, microservices architecture, RESTful API design).

- In-depth experience with React , state management (e.g., Redux, Context API), and modern front-end tooling/build workflows.

- Strong Experience with building Micro Front Ends in a React based environment.

- Solid understanding of relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) database design, indexing, and ORM frameworks (Hibernate / JPA).

- Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, system design, and security best practices.

- Proven track record with automated testing (JUnit, Mockito, Jest, React Testing Library) and CI/CD pipelines.
 Professional & Leadership Attributes 
 
- Autonomy and ownership: Ability to take business requirements from concept to production with minimal supervision.

- Strong problem-solving mindset with attention to detail, maintainability, and clean architecture (SOLID principles).

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 
 Education: 
 
- Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

jobs.jd:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase .

Senior Software Engineer, Tax Engineering

 Tax Engineering sits at the intersection of every trade, every payment, and every product Coinbase ships. When a user buys Bitcoin, sells an equity, earns staking rewards, or redeems an Advisor-managed strategy, Tax Engineering is in the critical path, calculating cost basis, tracking gain/loss, determining withholding obligations, and producing compliance reporting across every product line and legal entity globally. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Tax team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll build the extensible primitives that make each new Coinbase launch possible, where scale and accuracy are both non-negotiable.

 What you'll do:

- Own the design and delivery of backend systems for cost basis tracking, gain/loss calculation, withholding automation, and tax reporting infrastructure

- Build new pipelines for broker reporting, automated withholding, and clearing integrations with partners as Coinbase expands into equities, margin, and options

- Partner with Product, Design, Tax, Trading, and Positions teams to take ambiguous problems from scoping through production rollout

- Drive an extensible tax architecture so every new product launch can plug into shared primitives without bespoke rework

- Strengthen engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and technical mentorship across the team

 Required Skills and Experience:

- 6+ years of backend software engineering experience building and operating production systems with high-quality, well-tested code

- Strong distributed systems fundamentals, with experience designing high-throughput services and data pipelines where correctness is critical

- Track record owning complex systems end-to-end, from design through production operation, in fast-changing domains

- Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional partners to translate ambiguous requirements into shipped solutions

- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.jd:
Thought Machine's mission is bold – to properly and permanently rid the world's banks of legacy technology. To achieve this, we have developed the foundations of modern banking through core and payments technology which run natively in the cloud. What we are attempting is hard and means we need great people working together to build great technology.



We have grown rapidly in the past few years – growing our team to more than 550 individuals across offices in London, New York, Singapore, Sydney and our newly established Engineering Hub in Lisbon. We have raised more than £500m in funding and our investors include Molten Ventures, Eurazeo, Intesa Sanpaolo, Temasek, Nyca Partners, JPMorgan Chase Strategic Investments, Standard Chartered Ventures, and more.



We have created a culture that enables our team to produce the best work in the industry while ensuring we have fun along the way. We're regularly cited as having a fantastic workplace culture and have been recognised by Sifted magazine as having one of the highest Glassdoor ratings for a UK fintech company and the industry's most generous employee share package. Named one of the world's most innovative fintechs by Global Finance Magazine, we were also recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe's fastest-growing companies for two consecutive years—and a UK Best Employer for 2026.

At Thought Machine, our Senior Software Engineers specialised in Infrastructure play a crucial role in deploying and maintaining our cutting-edge software, developing tools and integrations with third-party infrastructure components used in our customers’ environments. Our team's mission is to abstract away multi-cloud complexity and reduce cognitive load for other developers. We treat our platform infrastructure which spans, orchestration, observability, and data. As a first-class product, enabling our internal teams and global clients to operate securely and reliably at massive scale.


Duties

 - Scale the Core Platform: Evolve, scale, and optimise the cloud-agnostic platform infrastructure powering Vault globally.

 - Simplify Orchestration: Build intuitive control planes and automation to further abstract away infrastructure complexity, significantly easing the cognitive load for Thought Machine engineers and bank SREs.

 - Design for Resiliency: Engineer robust, fault-tolerant architectures and Disaster Recovery / Business Continuity Planning (DR/BCP) systems.

 - Advance Observability: Enhance our comprehensive observability suites that are shared across the entire Thought Machine product ecosystem, providing clients with deep, out-of-the-box monitoring and insights

 - Optimise Data & Streaming: Scale and optimise core databases and event-streaming platforms to achieve maximum performance and scalability at the lowest cost

 

Essential

 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a similar technical field.

 - 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling infrastructure platforms (not just maintaining them).

 - Strong proficiency in building production-ready platform tooling using Python or Golang.

 - Deep understanding of container and orchestration internals (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).

 - Hands-on experience extending and integrating open-source tools like Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, and Grafana.

 - Proven ability to package and scale developer-facing infrastructure utilities with a focus on improving system reliability.

 

Desirable

 - Experience building cloud-agnostic solutions running across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

 - Technical depth in databases or event-streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Postgres, DuckDB).

 - A deep interest in the internals of infrastructure tools, with a track record of troubleshooting, extending, or optimizing them within a professional environment.

 

Benefits

 

 - Highly competitive salary and commission

 - Pension plan (match up to 5%)

 - Life insurance (3x annual salary)

 - Competitive maternity (six months fully paid) and paternity leave (four weeks fully paid)

 - Shared parental leave (matched to our maternity leave for the same point in time)

 - 25 days holiday and bank holidays

 - Flexible working hours

 - Cycle-to-work scheme

 - Electric car scheme

 - Season ticket loan

 - Access to outstanding learning materials and courses

 - Sports and hobby clubs, subsidised by Thought Machine

 - All the latest tech you need

 - Start the day properly with fresh fruit and cereals

 - Huge range of healthy (and not-so-healthy) snacks, smoothies and drinks

 - A talented and experienced team as your colleagues

 - An environment where we encourage learning and progress

 - Two charity days a year

 - Weekly food pop-up

We actively hire candidates who demonstrate technical excellence in their field and welcome people of all ages and backgrounds, providing everyone with equal access to professional development. You are encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't accurately match the job description. We also encourage applications from those with different abilities, including candidates with ADHD, autism, dyslexia or dyspraxia.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Java Full stack with AI
jobs.jd:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 

Software Engineer II - Java Full stack with AI

All About Us
MasterCard is a technology company in the global payments business. We connect consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments, and businesses worldwide and enable them to use secure and convenient electronic forms of payment.
 Join the industry’s most passionate, motivated & engaged global team - Our employees are encouraged to drive innovation every day in support of a more connected world – A World Beyond Cash.
 Overview:
The MasterCard D&S Technology development team is engaged in working with new and innovative technologies to build business solutions that keep MasterCard positioned as a leader in delivering value added business analytic and reporting solutions to our diverse customer base. We work collaboratively with our product partners and other technical teams to continuously improve and enhance our existing products and drive new products to the global marketplace. We are currently seeking candidates that will be responsible to support the technical lead in design and produce a high-quality code using different languages. 
 Role 
• Design and develop high quality, secure, scalable software solutions based on technical requirements specifications and design artifacts within expected time and budget.
• Work closely with Product Owners to develop beautiful, usable UIs and creative visualizations.
• Stay abreast of latest on the technology trends and industry best practices to hone and maintain your talent.
• Participate in architectural discussions, iteration planning, and feature sizing meetings.
• Develop code of high quality with customer focussed approach.
• Provide support during System and User Acceptance Testing.
• Adhere to Agile processes and participate actively in agile ceremonies.
 All About You
• Strong 3-6 years of experience in Full Stack Java application development and support, using modern and industry-standard development tools and practices.
• Hands-on experience with Java 8 or higher and Spring Framework (Spring 5 or above) for building scalable backend services.
• Proven experience in developing RESTful web services using Spring Boot / Spring REST APIs.
• Solid understanding of relational databases such as Oracle or SQL Server, with expertise in writing optimized and performant SQL queries.
• Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Angular for building responsive user interfaces.
• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Maven/Gradle, SonarQube, Chef, or equivalent automation tools.
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for application deployment, monitoring, and scaling, along with understanding of cloud-native and microservices architecture.
• Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• Hands-on experience or exposure to Databricks and big data ecosystems, including working with Spark-based data processing, ETL pipelines, or Delta Lake.
• Exposure to AI/ML concepts and AI-powered development tools (e.g., Copilot, AI-assisted testing, or code generation) and ability to integrate AI/ML services/APIs into applications.
• Familiarity with application servers and development environments including Tomcat, Apache, STS, Eclipse, IntelliJ IDEA, and Visual Studio Code.
• Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and experience working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) methodologies.
• Experience working in global, cross-functional teams, with strong technical problem-solving skills..
• Knowledge of Development of AI models and application with Python is preferred.

 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 
- Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

- Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

- Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 The senior technical architect, infrastructure and cloud sets direction for how our corporate and cloud infrastructure evolves to support secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective business services. As part of the technical architecture team, this role connects infrastructure and cloud decisions to enterprise architecture and the broader technology roadmap. The role researches new technologies, advises on current solutions, and drives improvement, including upgrades, retirements, and replacements. This is a senior individual contributor role that sets direction through standards, roadmaps, guardrails, and architecture decisions. 
 What you get to do in this role: 
 
- Help define the current-state, transition-state, and target-state infrastructure and cloud architecture, with a multiyear roadmap tied to business priorities, risk, lifecycle, capacity, and cost. Help align that direction with enterprise architecture principles and the broader technology roadmap, and surface dependencies that affect enterprise plans. 

- Establish reference architectures, principles, standards, and patterns across cloud, data center, networking, compute, storage, containers, and backup. Advise on infrastructure as code and policy as code, and support delivery teams in adopting them. 

- Help define cloud governance, standards, and architectural guardrails for Azure and GCP, including account and subscription structure, landing zones, cost controls, and policy as code. Advise teams on operating within them, and surface where a guardrail needs to change. 

- Lead infrastructure architecture reviews and provide architecture input on major technical decisions. Help scope proofs of concept and vendor evaluations. Evaluate options, document tradeoffs, risks, and value, fit, operability, and total cost, and help drive decisions to closure with accountable stakeholders. 

- Recommend resilience and compliance requirements for high availability, disaster recovery, backup and recovery, and continuity, and help align recovery objectives with business criticality. 

- Partner with Security Architecture on resilience, compliance, and zero-trust, so that security requirements are built into infrastructure and cloud standards from the start. 

- Look ahead to AI and ML infrastructure needs, including compute capacity, specialized hardware, data storage, and hybrid hosting. Understand the agentic AI patterns, such as RAG, A2A, and MCP, that shape those needs. Research emerging technologies that could change how we build and run infrastructure, and advise on when to adopt them. 

- Default to out-of-the-box capabilities. Recommend a documented case for any custom pattern or exception and advise on retiring custom solutions where a standard capability will do. 

- Support and collaborate regularly with the DT Integration, Core Systems, and Product teams to align infrastructure needs, dependencies, and roadmaps. Advise these teams on the infrastructure implications of their integration, core system, and product decisions, and help plan changes that depend on shared infrastructure. 

- Partner with finance and operations to inform infrastructure economics through capacity planning, lifecycle management, workload placement, and FinOps practices. Draw on incidents, capacity trends, audit findings, and resilience test results to inform standards and roadmaps. 

- Represent infrastructure and cloud in the architecture team and its governance forums, including the Architecture Review Board. Build trusted relationships with senior technology and business leaders, and mentor architects and engineers.

To be successful in this role you have: 
 
- 10+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, or systems engineering, including substantial architecture responsibility for complex enterprise environments. 

- Demonstrated success defining infrastructure and cloud strategy and roadmaps that span multiple technology domains and delivery teams. 

- Deep expertise in several infrastructure domains, with enough breadth to make integrated decisions across cloud, network, compute, storage, resilience, and cost. 

- Strong working knowledge of Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) architecture, including landing zones, connectivity, identity dependencies, workload placement, and shared-responsibility models. 

- Solid understanding of agentic AI concepts and patterns, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent-to-agent (A2A) communication, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and related technologies. 

- Experience integrating disparate systems, with a strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, such as APIs, messaging, and event-driven architecture. 

- Experience defining cloud governance, guardrails, and standards in a large enterprise, and getting teams to adopt them. 

- Experience creating and governing reference architectures, standards, and architecture decision records. 

- Working knowledge of infrastructure as code and modern automation practices. 

- Ability to evaluate architecture choices on business value, risk, cost, and operational evidence, not technology preference. 

- Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and technical teams without relying on direct authority. 

- Clear written and verbal communication for both engineering and executive audiences. 

- Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience. 

- Preferred qualifications 

- Experience in a large, global, regulated, or mission-critical environment. 

- Familiarity with IT service management practices, including the IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL), and with configuration management database (CMDB) alignment for infrastructure configuration items. 

- Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks, such as TOGAF or COBIT, or equivalent. 

- Experience with release planning using Agile and Scrum practices.

jobs.jd:
Make your mark by building the automation platform that keeps critical infrastructure running at enterprise scale. Join a team where your designs directly improve reliability, security, and delivery outcomes across a global technology estate. Grow your career through high-visibility, cross-organization impact and deep technical ownership in a regulated environment. 
 As a Principal Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within Infrastructure Platforms, you own the technical direction and delivery of an enterprise automation and orchestration platform. You design and build reusable automation capabilities that enable controlled configuration, orchestration, and run operations across large fleets of Windows, Linux, and network devices. You partner with engineering, operations, and risk stakeholders to deliver secure, resilient, and auditable software changes. You drive measurable improvements in delivery speed, quality, and operational outcomes through workflow automation and responsible use of enterprise-authorized artificial intelligence capabilities. 
 This role blends platform engineering and operational ownership for services that operate at significant scale and require strong control discipline. You will shape architecture standards, contribute hands-on engineering, and improve release practices so changes are repeatable, observable, and recoverable. You will integrate authentication, access controls, and security-by-design patterns directly into automation workflows. You will also help teams adopt artificial intelligence-enabled engineering automation in a way that is validated, traceable, and safe for sensitive data. 
 
 Job Responsibilities 
 
- Own the engineering and day-to-day reliability of an enterprise automation and orchestration platform supporting large-scale infrastructure automation across Windows, Linux, and network devices. 

- Define platform architecture, technical standards, and reusable automation patterns to improve consistency, quality, and time to delivery. 

- Build and deliver automation capabilities using Ansible and Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, including well-documented modules, collections, and runbooks that enable safe reuse. 

- Implement controlled release practices by integrating automated build, test, and deployment workflows using tooling such as Jenkins to support repeatable and auditable changes. 

- Improve platform observability by instrumenting monitoring, logging, alerting, and service health indicators that reduce time to detect and time to restore. 

- Embed security-by-design into automation workflows by integrating authentication and access mechanisms, privileged access considerations, and secure automation patterns. 

- Drive operational resilience by designing for failure, enabling safe rollback and recovery, and improving incident readiness through runbooks and automation-assisted triage. 

- Lead adoption of artificial intelligence-enabled engineering automation within the software delivery lifecycle by defining use cases, workflow integrations, and measurable success criteria. 

- Establish guardrails for artificial intelligence-enabled workflows, including human validation steps, quality gates, traceability, resiliency checks, and secure handling of sensitive inputs and outputs. 
 
 Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills 
 
- Demonstrated applied software engineering experience, supported by formal training or certification in software engineering concepts. 

- Strong experience in leading complex technical work through influence as a senior or principal engineer (architecture decisions, technical standards, delivery accountability). 

- Hands-on experience building and operating enterprise automation and orchestration solutions; Ansible experience required. 

- Experience with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform (including Ansible Tower), or similar enterprise scale automation software in production environments. 

- Experience designing and operating platforms with strong reliability requirements (monitoring, incident response readiness, and operational runbooks). 

- Experience implementing automated build, test, and deployment workflows using tools such as Jenkins. 

- Working knowledge of Windows and Linux administration concepts relevant to remote automation and configuration management. 

- Working knowledge of enterprise authentication and access methods used for automation (for example, Secure Shell and Windows Remote Management). 

- Experience applying secure engineering practices, including vulnerability remediation and patching processes, in regulated environments. 

- Experience leading adoption of enterprise-authorized artificial intelligence-assisted engineering practices with human validation steps and measurable outcomes. 

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field. 
 
 Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills 
 
- Experience automating network device configuration and operations at scale. 

- Experience with cloud-native architectures and cloud automation patterns. 

- Experience designing multi-tenant platforms with policy-based controls and delegated administration. 

- Experience modernizing automated testing approaches for infrastructure and platform engineering. 

- Experience coaching engineers through design reviews and code reviews across geographically distributed teams.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 The Okta Secures AI Team 

 The Okta Secures AI Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure. 

 Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.

 We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agent Identity—including pioneer work with the AI Agent Tool Registry and support for protocols like MCP and IPSIE. You will be helping us build the infrastructure that allows enterprises to scale AI safely, ensuring every access decision—whether made by a human or an automated agent—is authenticated, authorized, and audited at scale.

 We are a diverse team of engineers, product managers, and designers who are bringing Okta’s expertise in identity to define the future of Agent Identity management, focusing on enablement while staying secure.

 The Staff FullStack Engineer Opportunity 

 As a Staff Fullstack Engineer on the Okta Secures AI team, your mission is to build the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era.  You will lead the technical implementation of our four-pillar maturity model—Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern—to provide enterprise-grade visibility and governance for both human and non-human identities. By architecting solutions that move beyond reactive perimeter security, you will empower organizations to prevent "Shadow AI" and transform AI risk into business ROI.

 This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems and a commitment to AI-native engineering as our standard. You will rethink backend design, validation, and delivery through AI-augmented workflows, ensuring our platform provides secure, interoperable, and scalable access—enforcing the principle of least privilege for every agent action.

 What you’ll be doing

- Enforce secure access and least privilege for agents through capabilities like Agent Gateways and short-lived credentials.

- Drive continual evolution in the adoption of AI-native development practices, helping the team rethink how we design, review, and ship software with AI as a core part of the workflow.

- Proactively identify and prioritize tech debt; drive improvements in areas beyond feature work - CI/CD, observability, documentation, reliability, and support processes.

 Jira Platform will enable Jira to become the trusted, agent-native system of record and control plane for human and agent teamwork at enterprise scale.

 Your future team 
Jira Scalable Issue Search (JSIS) is a foundational investment in Jira platform, moving structured searches from a database-backed engine to OpenSearch.  The long-term opportunity extends beyond search: JSIS will provide the foundation for federated search across Jira portfolios and, ultimately, a shared search capability across Atlassian products. Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.



🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Wayve’s Robot Software group turns new vehicle programs into stable, reliable robot systems. The Platform Integration team works at the boundary between onboard software and vehicle hardware, bringing up new platforms while building reusable components and frameworks that make every future integration faster and more predictable.

As a Software Engineer on the Platform Integration team, you’ll combine hands-on vehicle and bench work with production software development. Your work will directly enable safe, scalable deployment across multiple vehicle programs.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 - Support software bring-up on benches, HiL systems, and vehicles, including work at international test locations.

 - Develop and maintain vehicle-facing software components and shared frameworks.

 - Diagnose integration issues across software and hardware boundaries and drive them through resolution.

 - Identify architectural improvements that reduce bespoke work and improve reuse.

 - Build diagnostics, tooling, and metrics for robot-software reliability and performance.

 - Produce clear documentation and runbooks for long-term supportability.

 - Collaborate with hardware, safety, controls, calibration, and reliability teams.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 - New vehicle-program bring-up across embedded compute, sensors, networks, and software services.

 - Linux-based robotic and automotive systems with multi-process and distributed architectures.

 - ROS2 or similar middleware, node development, message interfaces, and system integration.

 - Sensor calibration, synchronisation, data validation, and system-level debugging.

 - Automotive-grade compute platforms such as NVIDIA DRIVE and Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride.

 - Vehicle communication systems including CAN and Automotive Ethernet.

 - Shared abstractions and frameworks that improve reliability across programs.

 

🙌 You should apply if

 - You have strong software-development experience in C++, Python, or Rust.

 - You have delivered production-quality software on Linux-based robotic, embedded, or automotive platforms.

 - You understand ROS2 or similar robotics middleware and distributed-system integration.

 - You have hands-on experience integrating software with vehicle or embedded hardware.

 - You can diagnose complex problems using logs, telemetry, on-target tests, and systematic experimentation.

 - You understand vehicle sensors, networking, and the practical realities of platform bring-up.

Experience with drive-by-wire systems, CAN tools, shared frameworks, HiL or simulation, functional safety, technical documentation, or observability would be valuable.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Who We Are 

 At MongoDB, we are building the future of data platforms with MongoDB Atlas; our fully managed, multi-cloud database service. The Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) team sits within Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) in the CTO organization. We are an engineering team dedicated to building the security infrastructure, primitives, and reusable controls that protect MongoDB Atlas across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud (GCP).

 InfraSec operates on a preventative, enabling model: rather than acting as a manual approval gatekeeper or compliance auditor, we develop automated guardrails and platform capabilities. We integrate security directly into the platform runtime, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) workflows so engineering teams can operate securely at scale without friction.

 This role can be based out of NYC, San Francisco, Seattle, Austin, Dallas, Denver, Chicago, Washington DC, & Boston.

 What You’ll Do 

- Harden hosts and containerized workloads using Linux security mechanisms (AppArmor, SELinux, seccomp, cgroups) and eBPF-based tooling (Cilium, Tetragon)

- Secure containerized infrastructure across multi-cloud environments via RBAC, network policies, admission controls (Gatekeeper), and runtime threat detection.

- Build and manage automated services for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), workload identity, vulnerability management, and access controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP

- Write production-quality code and leverage Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) to version, test, and deploy security controls as code

- Build real-time security monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to detect anomalies and track security posture at Atlas scale

- Lead initiatives across their full lifecycle; from threat modeling and architectural design to implementation, rollout, and long-term production reliability

 What We’re Looking For 

 Minimum Qualifications: 

- 5+ years in SRE, Infrastructure Engineering, or Cloud Security Engineering

- Strong coding skills in Go (Golang), Python, C, C++, or Rust.

- Proven track record of building and operating large-scale distributed systems or cloud platform infrastructure.

- Hands-on experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible for automated infrastructure provisioning.

- Demonstrated experience owning infrastructure in Linux, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Practical experience with eBPF-based security tooling (Cilium, Falco, Tetragon)

- Direct ownership of Cloud Security and Workload Identity platforms

- Multi-cloud expertise spanning AWS, Azure, and GCP

- Production exposure to low-level Linux security mechanisms (seccomp, AppArmor, SELinux, cgroups)

 About MongoDB 

 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified database platform—the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market—helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world! 

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 

 MongoDB, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and makes all hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure.  We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
 
 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 
 
 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. jobs.jd:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.



🛠️ About our AI Platform Teams

Our AI Platform teams build the infrastructure that powers Wayve’s embodied AI. We store and serve hundreds of petabytes of driving data, growing towards exabyte scale, to support model training, simulation and data pipelines across regions and clouds.

As our first dedicated Staff Software Engineer for Storage Platform, you’ll set the technical direction for how we manage, protect and serve this data. Working closely with Infrastructure, Security, Privacy, Data Engineering and ML teams, you’ll help make training more efficient while reducing one of Wayve’s largest infrastructure costs.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 - Lead a hands-on, multi-quarter storage programme, from defining the problems and architecture to delivering platforms that teams adopt.

 - Build production services, controllers and infrastructure using Python, Go or a similar language, alongside Kubernetes and Terraform.

 - Partner with ML and data teams to understand access patterns, remove storage bottlenecks and reduce the time GPUs spend waiting for data.

 - Work with Security and Privacy to strengthen access controls, auditing and safe deletion of vehicle-collected data.

 - Write design documents and RFCs, align teams around shared standards, and mentor engineers as the platform and team grow.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 - Data ownership and governance: Give datasets clear owners, purposes and retention classes, with tagging and team-level cost attribution.

 - Safe lifecycle management: Build retention, deletion and re-tiering capabilities for Azure Blob, backed by dry runs, audit trails and recovery paths.

 - Read performance and caching: Improve throughput and latency by tackling small-object reads, throttling, unnecessary data access and cross-region hops.

 - Secure data movement: Design Kubernetes-native NVMe caching and secure replication across regions and clouds.

 - Measurable platform outcomes: Establish standards, dashboards and SLOs for availability, performance, cache effectiveness, storage tiers and cost.



🙌 You should apply if

 - You’ve operated at Staff Engineer scope, leading complex infrastructure programmes across multiple teams from problem definition through adoption.

 - You’ve owned petabyte-scale object storage end to end—including data layout, lifecycle management, performance and cost—with measurable outcomes against a cost target.

 - You’ve built scalable systems for data ownership, tagging, cataloguing, retention or deletion.

 - You bring strong security and access-management experience, including IAM/RBAC, encryption, secure replication and auditing.

 - You’re a hands-on software engineer with strong Python, Go or comparable skills, plus production Kubernetes, Terraform and CI experience. You build durable platforms and services, not just one-off scripts.

 - You can influence technical decisions without formal authority, mentor others and are excited to start in a founding, hands-on role with the opportunity to grow a team.

 - You can work on a hybrid basis from our London office.

Experience with AWS or GCP is welcome—you don’t need to have worked exclusively with Azure.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 - Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) - A conversation with our Talent Partner about your experience, interest in the role and practical details.

 - Competency Interviews (60 mins) - A programming interview to assess your hands-on software engineering skills.

 - Deep-dive technical interviews - A system design interview and a domain-specific interview

- Driving features and products idealization, implementation and adoption.

- Collaborate on planning and refinement proactively providing input whilst striving for engineering alignment, quality and reducing complexity and dependencies.

- Respond to alerts and duty responsibilities, like providing support to other engineers and troubleshooting production issues

 What you bring

 Nice to have

- Contributions to open-source observability projects

 This is a hands-on role for a Senior engineer who leads by building.  Hands-on full-stack engineering

 AI-augmented delivery

- Build agent workflows, prompt libraries and codebase knowledge context (knowledge graphs, vector databases, MCP integrations).

- Apply AI to reverse-engineering legacy code, generating specs, converting code and generating tests.

- Track AI productivity and quality (throughput, defect rates, rework, cost per migrated application) and report outcomes to leadership.
 Risk, controls and governance 
 
- Put human review checkpoints, audit trails and secure-coding gates on all AI-generated code, in line with State Street technology risk, information security and model governance policies.

- Make sure business logic extracted by AI is checked by subject-matter experts and confirmed through reconciliation before go-live.
 People and capability 
 
- Hire, coach and grow a permanent full-stack engineering team, and build AI fluency across the team.

- Manage vendor and temporary capacity and make sure knowledge transfers to permanent staff.
 
Required experience and skills
 
- 15+ years in software engineering, still actively coding, with 5+ years leading engineering teams on modernization or cloud migration programmes.

- Java: expert in Java 17+, Spring Boot, JPA, REST API design, Kafka/IBM MQ messaging and performance tuning.

- Databases: strong SQL; experience with Oracle and with migrating from Sybase or SQL Server.

- AI: proven hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agents in delivery, with measurable results.

- Comfort reading and reverse-engineering legacy code (COBOL, C/C++, PowerBuilder).

- Experience delivering in a regulated financial services environment.
 
Preferred
 
- Knowledge of investment servicing or middle-office areas: trade capture, confirmation, settlement, collateral, reconciliation, investment accounting.

- Experience building MCP servers, knowledge graphs or retrieval-augmented context for engineering agents.

- AWS Professional-level or equivalent certification.
 
Success measures (first 12–18 months)
 
- Personally delivered production code and reference implementations across the front end, back end and pipelines.

- An AI-augmented delivery model running across the programme, with productivity gains measured against a baseline.

- Modernization releases delivered to plan, with no material production incidents at cutover.

- A permanent full-stack team in place, able to run and evolve the new platform.

- No audit or control findings related to how AI is used in delivery.
 
Leadership attributes
 You make decisions and are comfortable with ambiguity. You're equally credible writing code, reviewing a pull request or presenting to senior stakeholders. You set the technical bar by example.

jobs.jd:
The role / impact

Reliability is a top strategic priority at Xero, directly influencing customer trust across more than 3,000 services. In this Site Reliability Engineering role, you will help shift reliability into a front-row discipline, moving beyond reactive fixes to uncover and resolve systemic resilience challenges across our global platform. You will partner closely with product teams to design reliability by default, ensuring our systems withstand unexpected events while supporting millions of small businesses.

You will take ownership of platform health by building automated tooling, championing chaos engineering experiments, and identifying potential failures before they impact customers. From coordinating incident management rituals and post-incident analysis to introducing load-shedding mechanisms, your contributions will directly safeguard platform availability and elevate engineering practices across the organisation.

The team / how they connect

You will join a focused Site Reliability Engineering team spanning Australia and the United States, responsible for incident management strategy, artificial intelligence operations tooling, and high-availability frameworks. The team works in close partnership with product and infrastructure squads across Xero, embedding alongside engineers to resolve shared reliability gaps and implement resilient design patterns. Together, the team shares incident commander responsibilities across regions, turning operational learnings into long-term systemic stability.

The team is currently working on / Initially, you will focus on

 - Working across a modern technical stack centred on Kubernetes, AWS (including ECS and managed services), Golang, Python, and C#.

 - Developing custom Kubernetes operators to automate storage resizing, alert provisioning, and reliability-by-default capabilities for development teams.

 - Enhancing telemetry pipelines to extract AWS-specific metrics from managed services and route actionable alerts directly to product squads.

 - Implementing chaos engineering scenarios to test infrastructure failure modes, alongside building API load shedding and rate limiting to protect services against traffic surges.

Where and how you can work

This role offers the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in Australia, with office hubs available in Sydney, Melbourne, and Brisbane. Whether you prefer working from home or coming into our collaborative spaces for team gatherings and boost days, we provide the autonomy to create a working routine that suits you best.

Here are some of the things we are looking for

 - You bring a solid background in site reliability engineering or DevOps, with experience diagnosing and strengthening distributed systems.

 - You have practical experience managing containerised workloads in Kubernetes and running infrastructure on cloud platforms such as AWS.

 - Your skillset includes practical coding proficiency in Golang, Python, or C#, coupled with curiosity for applying modern AI tools to operational challenges.

 - You display strong agency and initiative, proactively identifying operational friction and proposing sustainable technical solutions without waiting for instruction.

 - You demonstrate familiarity with incident management, participating in on-call responses and conducting post-incident reviews that translate into permanent fixes.

 - You possess clear communication skills, consistently linking technical reliability investments directly to customer needs and measurable business outcomes.

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

Working at Atlassian
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Your future team
 In Networking we build and operate shared services that route and protect traffic across Atlassian’s cloud infrastructure and products. Our work spans API gateways, rate limiting, service connectivity and real-time messaging, helping product teams deliver reliable experiences at scale.
 As a P50 Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build and operate distributed platform services. You will take projects from an ambiguous problem through design, implementation, rollout and production ownership, working with engineers, architects and internal customers across Atlassian.

What you’ll do
 
- Build and evolve reliable, resilient, high-throughput and low-latency backend services.

- Evolve shared networking services across AWS, GCP and Kubernetes, delivering safe migrations that preserve compatibility and reliability for dependent teams.

- Build traffic-control capabilities that protect services from bursts, enforce quotas fairly and give engineers visibility into throttling decisions.

- Own projects end to end: clarify requirements, evaluate design tradeoffs, implement and test changes, plan safe rollouts and measure their results.

- Improve platform reliability, performance, scalability and operational efficiency.

- Participate in the team’s production support and on-call responsibilities, investigate incidents and deliver lasting improvements.

- Work with partner teams to understand their needs and deliver reusable platform capabilities.

- Mentor engineers, provide thoughtful code and design reviews, share knowledge and improve engineering practices.

What you’ll bring
 
- Experience independently delivering and operating backend services in production at scale, with the technical judgment expected of a senior engineer.

- Strong software development skills in one or more of Java, Kotlin, Go or Python, and willingness to work across the team’s stack.

- A sound understanding of networking protocols, distributed systems, microservices, HTTP and REST APIs, including their failure modes and performance tradeoffs.

- Experience debugging complex production issues using logs, metrics and other observability tools.

- Experience with automated testing, continuous delivery and safe changes to production services.

- Clear communication, effective collaboration across teams and a track record of mentoring other engineers.

Additional experience we’d value
 
- API and traffic management, rate limiting, authentication or service-to-service connectivity.

- Cloud infrastructure, such as AWS and GCP, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

- Building a service from the initial requirements through launch and ongoing ownership.

- Improving on-call practices, incident response, service reliability or infrastructure cost efficiency.

Proposed first 6–12 month outcomes
 
- Develop enough knowledge of the team’s services and dependencies to contribute confidently to operations and incident response.

- Own a networking platform capability or migration through production rollout and adoption, demonstrating an agreed improvement in reliability, latency, operating cost or developer effort.

- Deliver measurable reliability, performance or operational improvements and share the resulting knowledge across the team.

- Support the growth of other engineers through mentoring, design collaboration and high-quality reviews.

Benefits & Perks 
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits . 
 About Atlassian 
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh .

jobs.jd:
Join us in building the future of finance.

 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

 About the team + role 

 We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

 The Capacity & Efficiency Engineering team builds the software that manages, governs, and reduces Robinhood's AWS cloud spend across compute, databases, and storage, operating at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and FinOps. We own the full lifecycle of cloud cost, from attribution and forecasting to automation that rightsizes infrastructure at fleet scale and keeps a bursty, latency-sensitive trading platform both reliable and cost-effective. Our work carries CEO-level visibility, has already driven millions of dollars in annualized savings, and is delivered in close partnership with Infrastructure, Finance, and product engineering teams across Robinhood.

 As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will own capacity and efficiency for Robinhood's storage and database fleet, from Aurora clusters to S3 and the caches and volumes in between. You will build the systems that size this fleet to demand: Aurora reader counts and writer sizes set from market hours, declared events, and live load instead of fixed schedules; databases, caches, and volumes rightsized to what they actually use; and S3 data kept in the right storage class, with lifecycle rules that keep growth in check. You will take each from recommendations the Storage team validates to automation that safely applies its own changes in production. This is a 0-to-1 build with measurable impact on reliability at market peaks and on the AWS bill.

 This role is based in our Bellevue, WA office , with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week .

 At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

 What you’ll do 

- Build forecast-driven capacity planning for the storage and database fleet, turning traffic history, load tests, and known events (market open, earnings, IPOs, promotions) into plans that scale up ahead and back down after, with an expiry on every temporary capacity hold

- Design and build a capacity planner for Aurora that sets reader counts and writer instance sizes from demand and load signals (IOPS, CPU, connections, replica lag), replacing fixed scaling schedules

- Rightsize databases, caches, and block storage (RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, EBS) on instance size, provisioned IOPS and throughput, and idle capacity, and keep them right-sized as load changes

- Own S3 efficiency at scale: storage class and Intelligent-Tiering strategy, lifecycle and retention policies, noncurrent versions and incomplete uploads, and request costs, using Storage Lens and inventory data

- Take every recommendation to closed-loop automation with guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback, in partnership with the Storage infrastructure team, handling constraints such as AWS capacity shortages, fallback instance types, and connection pooling

- Measure outcomes in cost and reliability (savings against baseline, forecast error, utilization, capacity left behind after events) and share our forecasts with the pod rightsizing system so compute and storage scale together

 What you bring 

- Deep hands-on experience operating AWS storage and databases at scale, especially Aurora or RDS (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and S3, including replication, read scaling, storage classes, and lifecycle management

- Capacity planning and forecasting experience: modeling time-series demand, load testing, and translating traffic into instance counts, sizes, and storage growth

- A track record of rightsizing infrastructure from utilization data (CPU, memory, IOPS, throughput, bytes stored) without hurting latency or availability

- Strong Python or Go engineering, with experience building automation that safely modifies production infrastructure (guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback built in), not just systems that observe and report

- Familiarity with AWS storage and database pricing (S3 storage classes and requests, Aurora I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Reserved Instances) is a strong plus

- Experience with bursty, event-driven workloads (trading, payments, ticketing) or with Spark, Airflow, or Kubernetes is a plus

 What we offer 

- Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.

- Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.

- Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.

- Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.

- Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.

- Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

- Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 

Senior Platform Architect (Infrastructure Design, IaaS, Cloud Architecture, F5, Network Security)

Overview:

Who is Mastercard? Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible

Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview 
The Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Senior Platform Architect to lead the design and evolution of secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise infrastructure platforms that power Mastercard's critical business services. 

The ideal candidate is a strategic technology leader with deep expertise in enterprise architecture, infrastructure engineering, and cloud technologies. 

They are highly collaborative, intellectually curious, and passionate about solving complex technical challenges while driving innovation, operational excellence, and platform modernization.

This individual excels at partnering across engineering, security, and product organizations to deliver scalable solutions that enable business growth and provide exceptional customer experiences.

All About You Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience
• 5-9 years of overall career experience in a similar role or Technology
• Deep expertise in enterprise infrastructure architecture across data center, hybrid cloud, and distributed computing environments. 
• Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking, application delivery, and infrastructure security, including Zero Trust principles and modern network architectures. 
• Experience designing and supporting enterprise platforms utilizing VMware, cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure. 
• Strong expertise in infrastructure automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD integration, and configuration management using tools such as Git, Bitbucket, and Jenkins.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence technical and executive stakeholders. Desirable or Additional Capabilities
• Expertise in infrastructure performance engineering, including capacity planning, scalability testing, and performance optimization.
 • Advanced experience creating technical architecture documentation and executive presentations using Microsoft Visio.
 • Experience supporting mission-critical financial services platforms with stringent availability, security, resiliency, and regulatory compliance requirements.

Role 
• Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of highly available, scalable, and secure enterprise infrastructure solutions across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments. 
• Partner with Engineering, Network, Security, Cloud, Database, Middleware, Product, and Program Management teams to develop infrastructure solutions that support business and technology strategies. 
• Drive infrastructure solution delivery from initial business engagement through architecture reviews, financial approvals, procurement, implementation, operational readiness, and production deployment.
 • Design resilient networking, application delivery, and security architectures utilizing enterprise technologies including load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure platforms. 
• Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives focused on automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), platform standardization, performance optimization, resiliency, and operational excellence. 
• Develop enterprise architecture standards, technical roadmaps, and infrastructure documentation while mentoring engineering teams and promoting engineering best practices.
 • Ensure infrastructure solutions meet stringent requirements for security, compliance, availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and performance across mission-critical platforms.

 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 
- Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

- Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

- Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.




🛠️ ABOUT OUR ENGINEERING TEAMS

Wayve’s engineering teams are building the AI, robotics, simulation, data, and systems foundations needed to deploy a generalisable AI Driver safely and at scale.




ABOUT AI VALIDATION

The AI Validation team builds trust in the Wayve AI Driver. We create the strategies, metrics, test suites, and evidence used to assess learned driving behaviour across simulation and real-world testing, supporting product releases and customer programmes.




🧠 YOUR DAY-TO-DAY

 - Lead validation strategy for advanced driver-assistance and autonomous-driving functions across multiple test modalities.

 - Translate product and safety requirements into measurable coverage, acceptance criteria, and validation plans.

 - Work hands-on with Python-based evaluation tools, metrics, simulation results, and large datasets.

 - Analyse validation outcomes and communicate clear evidence to Product, Safety, Release, and Autonomy Engineering stakeholders.

 - Coordinate dependencies across data, simulation, evaluation, and engineering teams so validation can run reliably at scale.

 - Provide technical leadership and raise the quality bar for systems validation in ambiguous, fast-moving programmes.




🧩 WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

 - Comprehensive verification strategies for ADAS and autonomy functions within the Wayve AI Driver.

 - Test suites spanning simulated scenarios and physical vehicle testing.

 - Behaviour metrics and evidence that connect system requirements to real driving performance.

 - Scalable, automated validation workflows that support multiple products and customer deployments.

 - Validation approaches for learned and adaptive behaviours as end-to-end AI systems evolve.




🙌 YOU SHOULD APPLY IF

 - You have significant experience validating complex automotive, autonomous-driving, robotics, aerospace, or similarly safety-relevant systems.

 - You have led validation concepts from initial ambiguity through implementation, execution, and reporting.

 - You can use Python to implement metrics and work within evaluation codebases; SQL experience is valuable.

 - You understand simulated and physical testing and can make evidence-based decisions from imperfect data.

 - You communicate crisply, document decisions well, and can align technical stakeholders across disciplines.

 - Experience with ML, computer vision, motion planning, data science, SOTIF, safety validation, or agentic AI workflows is beneficial.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.




MORE ABOUT WAYVE

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand-coded rules or pre-mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2+ through to L4 as our core AI model scales.




HOW WE WORK 💻 — LOCATIONS & FLEXIBLE WORKING

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely.




🔍 THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 - Initial call / recruiter screen — 30 minutes

 - Competency interviews, including programming and hiring-manager discussion — approximately 2 hours total

 - Deep-dive technical interviews covering systems and domain expertise — approximately 3 hours total

 - Final interview focused on mission and values alignment — 1 hour

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.




WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU (LOCATION DEPENDENT)

 - 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually

 - 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in Wayve’s long-term success

 - ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable

 - ✅ Hybrid working, core hours, and opportunities to work hands-on in vehicle workshops and labs

 - 📚 Learning and development support for training, conferences, and growth

 - 🩺 Comprehensive location-dependent benefits, including health coverage, family leave, retirement or pension support, wellbeing resources, and team socials
   

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.



If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

 Adobe is reimagining the future of creativity — where generative AI, intelligent agents, and human imagination work hand in hand.  Supply chain leaders are being asked to cut costs and carbon at the same time. Yet logistics and sustainability teams often work with different data, tools, and priorities. Meanwhile, regulations and industry standards are raising expectations for how companies measure and manage their emissions.

 Most climate tools stop at reporting: a dashboard or a year-end PDF, produced long after a shipment has moved. They rarely reach the people deciding how to route goods, when to ship, or how much inventory to hold.

 The Climate team at Flexport is building emissions intelligence directly into the platform where supply chain decisions are made. We help customers weigh cost, speed, and emissions together—and turn that understanding into action.

- Building simple, reliable products and learning from how people use them.

- Finding opportunities where lower costs and lower emissions go together.

- Help customers identify opportunities to reduce emissions using Flexport’s shipment data.

 You Should Have

- A bias for action, combined with the judgment to recognize when you need input or help.

 Nice to Have

- Experience in climate technology, emissions accounting, logistics, or supply chain software.

- Experience building products in a startup or another small team with broad ownership.

- Experience turning complex data into customer-facing insights and decision tools.

 Prior climate experience is a plus; curiosity and the ability to learn the domain matter more.

 How We Work
