jobs.jd:
About Anthropic 

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

 Platform Intelligence turns each new Claude model's abilities into API features that developers can build on. Our goal is to make the full intelligence of each model available through the API. We own the capabilities that shape what Claude can do for developers: tool use, built-in tools such as web search and code execution, thinking controls, structured outputs, and the memory, files, and skills APIs.

 We also run the API side of every Claude model launch, including its safety features and controls. That means getting the API ready for each new model, coordinating with research, safeguards, product, and cloud partners, and making sure the model, its features, the SDKs, and the docs all ship together on launch day.

 The work sits where research meets product. We work with new models before they are public. When a model gains a new ability, we work out what it should look like as an API, build it, and ship it to developers on our own platform and on cloud platforms. Those decisions shape how developers first use each model. We also own API versioning and the evals that tell us a capability works in production.

What you'll do

 You'll lead the design, build, and operation of API capabilities used by developers around the world. You'll work with research to understand what a new model can do and turn that into an interface that is simple, durable, and hard to misuse.

 You'll lead the API side of new model launches. You'll plan the work, track readiness across teams, resolve the issues that come up late, and see the launch through on the day. Between launches, you'll make the next one faster and safer.

 You'll set technical direction for work that spans several teams, write clear design proposals, review API designs from other teams, and mentor engineers on the team.

Representative projects

- Lead API readiness for a Claude model launch, so that every feature works on day one across our API, SDKs, docs, and cloud partners

- Take a new model ability from research prototype to public API feature, from interface design to production rollout

- Build and operate tools such as web search and code execution under real traffic

- Automate the manual parts of a model launch

- Build the evals that catch a capability regression before a launch

You might be a good fit if you:

- Have led technical projects that spanned several teams, from design through launch and operation

- Have designed and operated production distributed systems where correctness, latency, and availability all matter

- Have strong product sense and care about API design and developer experience

- Make sound technical decisions with incomplete information, as models and priorities change close to a launch

- Explain tradeoffs clearly to research, product, and go-to-market partners, including non-engineers

- Make the engineers around you better through design review and mentoring

- Use AI tools as a regular part of how you design, build, and review software

- Care about the societal impacts of your work and Anthropic's mission to build safe, beneficial AI

 Strong candidates may also have: 

- Building public APIs, SDKs, or developer platforms

- Working with large language models, including tool use, agents, or evals

- Running launches or migrations with fixed deadlines and many dependent teams

- Building tools for agents, such as search or code execution

- Storage, memory, or context systems at scale

- Integrating with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure

 Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 

 Location Preference: Preference will be given to candidates based in NY, SEA, SF or the Bay Area given the current location of team. 
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

 Annual Salary:
 $405,000 — $485,000 USD 

 Logistics

 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

jobs.jd:
We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.
 
As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Commercial and Investment Banking Technology team, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, your role requires to partner across software engineering, product, infrastructure, cyber, and production support teams to improve service health, resiliency, and client experience. You will serve as a trusted technical authority during major incidents, production readiness reviews, resiliency exercises, and operational governance activities while championing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and modern engineering practices. 
 
 Job Responsibilities 
 
- Serve as the technical production owner for critical Recon services and client-facing platforms, driving reliability, availability, scalability, operational efficiency, and client experience through SRE principles.

 Okta is The World's Identity Company.  At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we're looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.

The Engineering Opportunity

 Okta's Workforce Identity Cloud secures billions of global logins every day. The Platform Scalability team within the Resilience organization owns the speed, efficiency, and scale of Okta's core authentication and authorization service. We analyze and optimize system behavior across every layer of the stack - from virtualized hardware and the JVM, through MySQL query execution, caching, and the edge, up to cloud components (AWS/GCP) and application code - and we build the frameworks that keep the platform fast and protected for thousands of organizations and millions of daily active users.

 We are seeking a Senior Back-End Software Engineer to help own the scalability, efficiency, and service protection of our expanding Identity as a Service platform.

 You will build traffic-shaping and service-protection frameworks (rate limiting, concurrency limits, query timeouts, read isolation), create tooling and automation that makes latency and resource bottlenecks easy to find, and dig into production metrics to understand how the system behaves under real customer traffic. While SRE and Database Reliability Engineering keep the service up and running, the Platform Scalability team keeps it fast and efficient - and we partner closely with them to get there.

 Because we own monitoring of system latency, throughput, and resource utilization, this is not a heads-down coding role: keeping an eye on system health is part of the regular rhythm of the job, alongside project work and deep-dive investigations.

 We value iterative development, automated testing, and individual ownership. Join our creative, fast-paced team to work on impactful projects at serious scale.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

- Design and implement backend frameworks that protect and optimize critical system resources, including rate limiting, traffic shaping, concurrency controls, and query timeout enforcement.

- Monitor production latency, throughput, and resource utilization across the database, application, cache, and edge layers; create and maintain meaningful metrics, dashboards, and alerts, often through automated tooling.

- Analyze latency and scalability bottlenecks end-to-end - JVM profiling, thread and heap analysis, SQL query plans, slow logs, and Hibernate behavior - and drive fixes in code, SQL, and configuration.

- Perform capacity and cost-efficiency analysis (for example, determining whether databases and compute are right-sized for current load), participate in weekly metrics reviews, and support onboarding of large customers and high-traffic events.

- Advise engineering teams on scalable, efficient feature design; review pull requests and SQL changes for latency, resource, and scale impact and recommend tuning or refactoring.

- Actively explore and integrate modern AI-driven developer tooling, automated diagnostics, and intelligent monitoring to accelerate latency and capacity investigations, automate analysis of metrics and logs, and reduce toil.

- Write high-quality unit and functional tests and participate in design and code reviews to keep the engineering bar high.

- Participate in on-call rotations handling latency and scale-related customer escalations, rate limit requests, and production incidents; contribute to Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and long-term mitigations.

- Collaborate closely with SRE, Database Reliability Engineering, Architects, QA, Product Owners, and Customer Support to deliver secure and dependable software.

Minimum Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Competitive Benchmarking & Performance
jobs.jd:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role 

 Elasticsearch powers search, observability, and AI retrieval (RAG) for the world's largest organizations. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead competitive benchmarking initiatives within the Elasticsearch Performance team. 

 You will develop representative workloads, automate reproducible experiments, and investigate how Elasticsearch compares with alternative systems. Your work will identify performance strengths, gaps, and tradeoffs, guide engineering improvements, and help customers make informed technical decisions.

 This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building benchmarks and investigating performance, with technical publishing as a shared responsibility alongside engineering and content partners.

 A typical investigation might ask how Elasticsearch and an alternative system compare under concurrent ingestion and hybrid search, at comparable retrieval quality and cost, and which engineering changes would improve the outcome. This role offers the opportunity to connect deep performance analysis with product improvements and public technical work.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- Own prioritized competitive benchmarking initiatives across search, vector and hybrid retrieval, and analytical and observability workloads.

- Build and maintain automated benchmark harnesses, datasets, query sets, and load profiles that reflect real-world usage, including concurrent ingestion and querying.

- Design fair comparisons with documented system versions, configurations, tuning decisions, resource budgets, and functional differences.

- Evaluate latency distributions, throughput, resource consumption, and cost efficiency. For retrieval workloads, measure performance at comparable recall or relevance targets.

- Adapt and extend workload-appropriate tools such as Elasticsearch Rally, ClickBench, and vector search benchmark frameworks.

- Investigate performance differences using profiling, system metrics, and controlled experiments; collaborate with engineering teams to identify causes and validate improvements.

- Evaluate relevant self-managed and managed cloud deployments, including serverless offerings, accounting for scaling behavior and service constraints.

- Work with engineering and technical content partners to publish reproducible benchmark artifacts and clear technical reports that explain methodology, findings, limitations, and tradeoffs.

- Partner with engineering and product management to prioritize benchmark coverage and translate findings into actionable product improvements.

What You Bring 

- Solid software engineering skills, with experience building maintainable automation and analysis tools in Python or another relevant programming language.

- Hands-on experience evaluating and diagnosing performance in distributed systems, databases, or search infrastructure.

- Depth in at least one relevant area (search, vector retrieval, analytical databases, or observability systems) and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

- Experience designing representative datasets and workloads, including query patterns, concurrency, and ingestion behavior.

- Sound experimental judgment, including repeated measurements, variability analysis, warm-up and cache effects, and the distinction between meaningful changes and measurement noise.

- Experience building reproducible test environments and documenting configurations, procedures, and results.

- Clear technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings and their limitations.

- Solid collaboration skills and the ability to turn performance evidence into applicable engineering recommendations.

Bonus Points

- Experience with Elasticsearch, Lucene, Rally, ClickBench, or vector search benchmark frameworks.

- Experience measuring retrieval quality alongside latency, throughput, and resource usage.

- Familiarity with cloud performance and cost analysis, including autoscaling and serverless systems.

- Public technical writing, open-source contributions, or published benchmark studies.

 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below. 

 These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future. 

 An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

 Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

 The typical starting salary range for this role is:
 $128,300

This team focuses on optimizing efficiency and resiliency of ML workloads, as well as developing scalable AI infrastructure tools and services. Our objective is to deliver a stable, scalable environment for AI researchers, providing them with the vital resources and scale to champion innovation.
 
 We are seeking a distributed software engineer to join our team! As a Senior engineer, you'll be instrumental in developing and optimizing AI infrastructure services to bring peak AI performance and high resiliency for DGX Cloud. Your expertise in cloud services software architecture that drives the full resilience stack that will deliver an AI platform that redefines what is possible. This is an exceptional opportunity to push the boundaries of technology and shape the future of AI and the Cloud, and work with a world-class team of like-minded engineers.
 
 What You Will Be Doing: 
 As a software engineer specializing in backend development, you'll work in a dedicated team to enhance the infrastructure and products that underpin NVIDIA's AI platforms. Your work will be essential in enabling innovative AI research, focusing on:
 
- Developing solutions at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and high-performance computing, supplying to the advancement of AI technologies.

- Designing, developing, and optimizing (micro-)services orchestrated by Kubernetes to provide large-scale AI training workflows on AI training supercomputers located at major CSPs, with resiliency and efficiency.

- Co-designing and implementing the APIs that allow these services to integrate vertically with NVIDIA's resiliency stacks, ranging from tier-0 telemetry services to break/fix automation services to checkpoint and execution systems.

- Crafting a submission abstraction that enables model engineers and training platforms/frameworks to seamlessly submit long-running training jobs while hiding the complexity of handling infrastructure failures, running job lifecycles with auto-restarts on failure, ensuring full efficiency, and promptly advising users.

- Crafting these services to be modular, enabling them to be coordinated with and deployed onto on-premises AI clusters that apply NVIDIA Hardware and Cloud services.

jobs.title: Senior GPU Networking Architect
jobs.jd:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 
 We are looking for a Senior GPU Networking Architect to join our networking software group, bringing strong GPU architecture and programming skills to build and improve GPU communication kernels. This role links GPU computing with networking by making sure communication primitives are carefully developed alongside GPU hardware capabilities. Join our team of engineers developing the software foundation for the largest AI systems globally.
 
 What you will be doing: 
 
- Build, implement, and optimize GPU communication kernels that underpin collective and point-to-point operations in large-scale AI systems.

- Leverage deep knowledge of GPU architecture—thread scheduling, memory hierarchy, execution pipelines—to improve kernel efficiency, minimize latency, and overlap computation with communication.

- Develop GPU-resident communication primitives and device-side APIs that enable fine-grained, kernel-initiated data movement across nodes and accelerators.

- Profile and tune GPU kernels end-to-end, identifying bottlenecks at the intersection of compute, memory, and network, and driving targeted optimizations.

- Collaborate with network software, hardware, and AI framework teams to co-design communication strategies that align with GPU execution patterns and emerging model architectures.

- Build proofs-of-concept, conduct experiments, and perform quantitative modeling to evaluate and validate new communication strategies before committing them to production.

- Contribute to the evolution of programming models that expose GPU-aware networking capabilities to application developers.

 What we need to see: 
 
- 5+ years of hands-on CUDA programming, including writing and optimizing non-trivial GPU kernels.

- M.Sc. or equivalent experience in computer science, computer engineering, or a closely related field.

- Strong understanding of GPU architecture fundamentals: warp scheduling, shared memory, L2 cache, memory coalescing, occupancy tuning, and asynchronous execution.

- Experience with systems-level C/C++ development in performance-critical environments.

- Familiarity with GPU data movement mechanisms such as GPUDirect RDMA and GPU-initiated communication.

- Ability to read and reason about GPU performance profiles (e.g., Nsight Compute, Nsight Systems) and translate observations into actionable optimizations.

- Strong collaboration skills in a multi-national, interdisciplinary environment.

 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 
- Experience developing or optimizing communication kernels in libraries such as NCCL, NVSHMEM, or similar GPU-aware communication frameworks.

- Understanding of distributed deep learning parallelism techniques, including data parallelism, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, expert parallelism, and mixture-of-experts parallelism, and the communication patterns they impose on GPU kernels.

- Background in RDMA, InfiniBand, high-speed networking, and GPU system topology, including NVLink, NVSwitch, PCIe, and network fabrics, and their impact on communication kernel design.

- Experience with overlap techniques such as kernel pipelining, persistent kernels, or cooperative groups to hide communication latency behind compute.

- Proven experience evaluating and optimizing large-scale LLM training or inference workloads, including hands-on work with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorRT-LLM, or vLLM, and familiarity with emerging serving architectures such as disaggregated serving.

 At NVIDIA, you'll work alongside colleagues who demonstrate deep expertise and innovative thinking in the industry, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in AI and high-performance computing. If you're passionate about GPU architecture, low-level kernel optimization, and building the communication fabric for next-generation AI, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Supportability Decisions
jobs.jd:
Who we are

About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About the team

 Supportability Decisions is a Dublin-based engineering team within Supportability Engineering, part of Risk Engineering. We own the “how a business sells” side of Supportability: determining whether a user’s declared business, web presence, account configuration, and observed transaction behaviour align with Stripe’s standards.

 Our core domain includes transaction-laundering detection and decisioning, web-presence and URL-policy controls, and low-quality e-commerce detection. We consume the signals and evaluations that support decisions in these spaces and convert them into evidence-based and auditable determinations that can be shared with the rest of the Supportability platforms.

 The pitch is: join a high-ownership team solving some of Stripe’s hardest risk problems. We build technology that helps Stripe distinguish legitimate businesses from bad actors at scale, combining sophisticated engineering, AI-assisted investigation, and meaningful real-world impact.

What you’ll do

 You will own a meaningful part of a risk-decisioning problem from investigation and design through implementation, rollout, measurement, and iteration. You will help build both the domain capabilities and the modern agentic infrastructure required to make Supportability decisions consistent, stateful, explainable, and appropriate to the business, product, and moment in time. Depending on team priorities and the candidate’s experience, this may include:

Responsibilities

- Building the Supportability Decision Layer: a durable service and API through which automated systems, agents, and human reviewers can request, produce, retrieve, and understand canonical decisions.

- Developing the infrastructure that enables agentic investigations to synthesize policy, business identity and history, product context, risk appetite, and multiple assessment signals into explainable, confidence-calibrated decisions.

- Improving the transaction-laundering agent’s policy grounding, evidence quality, risk tiering, precision and recall, and use of behavioural, dispute, and other relevant signals.

- Designing durable decision state and history, including traceability from supporting evidence through reasoning and applied consequence, and validity and refresh policies that prevent stale outcomes from persisting.

- Building governed, reusable configuration and integration patterns that adapt decision capabilities across products, partners, countries, and permitted risk appetites without creating bespoke systems for each use case.

- Building reliable backend workflows on shared Supportability and Risk Platform infrastructure.

- Making complex risk decisions explainable to reviewers and affected users.

- Using data and feedback from outcomes, appeals, and corrections to improve decision quality while balancing the identification of bad actors against avoiding unnecessary harm to legitimate businesses.

- Modernising URL enforcement, including when and how URL checks run, reducing unnecessary review volume and user friction, and supporting migration away from legacy systems.

- Expanding shared SAE/SPO decisioning foundations, including due-diligence support and product-scoped remediation and appeal capabilities.

- Improving the Process Orchestration Framework and moving workflow code into more maintainable platform packages.

- Contributing to future work in automated LPM URL screening, low-quality e-commerce detection, wider web intelligence, and active test charges.

 Who you are 

 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

Minimum requirements

- 2 - 7 years of industry software engineering experience (does not include internships or co-ops)

- You work effectively across the stack from top to bottom, comfortably navigating codebases with different languages and tools

- You're equally comfortable shipping user-facing experiences as you are writing custom queries to analyze experiment results

- Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job, so our interview process is language-agnostic)

- Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success

- Ability to thrive on a high level of autonomy and responsibility, and think of yourself as entrepreneurial

- Interest in working as a generalist across varying technologies and stacks to solve problems and delight both internal and external users

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in high-growth teams similar to Stripe

- Experience building financial systems or tools for financial experts

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 The Principal Software Engineer Opportunity 

 The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta's co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

 You will build the harnesses and evaluations that make these workers reliable. They investigate risk, use tools, wait for approvals and complete tasks across enterprise systems. Bring depth in agent execution or model quality and help turn it into working software customers can trust.

 About You 

 Production builder : You have shipped AI software and know what changes when real users depend on it.

 Careful evaluator : You investigate failures and use evidence to judge quality.

 Strong owner: You follow an improvement through code, evaluation, release and customer use.

 What you will be doing 

- Build the agent harness for planning, tool use, memory, context compaction, interruption and recovery during long-running work.

- Integrate OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs. Select models using measured quality, latency and cost, with clear failure handling.

- Evaluate existing harnesses and build only the missing pieces. Keep the harness connected to AWS workflow execution and approval state.

- Keep authorization and sensitive writes behind application policy checks. Require evidence of the resulting state before marking work complete.

- Build evaluation datasets and replay tests for valid findings, access decisions, app setup and AI agent onboarding.

- Measure false positives, missed risks, unsafe actions, completion rate and cost. Turn production failures into regression tests.

- Test prompt injection, stale evidence, conflicting instructions and unsafe tool use. Protect tenant boundaries in retrieval and memory.

- Improve prompts, retrieval, tools and model routing. Evaluate fine-tuning or other post-training methods when results justify them and data use is approved.

 What you will bring to the role 

- Strong Python engineering skills and experience shipping an LLM application that uses tools.

- Hands-on experience building agent workflows or evaluation systems for tool-using LLM applications. For harness work, relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a custom implementation.

- Experience integrating model APIs, structured outputs and asynchronous services. Experience with OpenAI or Anthropic is especially relevant.

- Depth in agent execution or evaluation systems, with working code and failure analysis you can explain.

- Ability to distinguish a plausible model response from a supported finding or verified action.

 Scope by level 

 Principal: Set product engineering direction across workflows and implement the shared components that help the team ship faster.

 Our stack 

 Our core stack is Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS and pgvector. OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs are part of the integration plan.

 We plan to add an agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery. The harness choice is open. Experience with equivalent tools also counts.

 And extra credit for 

- Open-source contributions, agent observability, security evaluations or synthetic evaluation data.

- Fine-tuning, preference data, post-training evaluation or model distillation using approved datasets.

- Identity and security workflows. Foundation-model research experience is optional.

 This role reports to the Senior Manager, Professional Services Engineering who is based in Boston, Massachusetts.

 What you will be doing: 

- Shape the future of our Professional Services organization and contribute to the development of processes and procedures.

- Tackle challenging Story and workflow builds to power our customers’ most important workflows.

- Scope automation Stories based on customer requirements, identifying any blockers and research areas needed.

- Analyze customer tools, processes, and pain points to guide them in establishing an automation roadmap.

- Identify and highlight what is, and what isn’t, suitable for an automation workflow.

- Partner closely with customers to ensure that the Stories and workflows meet their requirements and provide guidance on test plans.

- Review and suggest optimizations for customer stories and workflows.

- Deliver documented, production-ready stories and workflows to customers and ensure the customer is set up for success in maintaining those long-term.

- Act as a resident automation engineer for customers, working as a member of the customer team to help them plan their automation roadmap and achieve their automation goals.

- Advocate for the Professional Services Team within Tines, working with Sales teams to ensure they can speak to our capabilities and achievements.

 What you bring with you: 

- 5+ years of experience in delivering Professional Services and implementing SOAR platforms or similar automation solutions.

- Strong customer-facing skills and experience.

- A passion for becoming an expert in a Tines.

- Proficient in assessing and understanding customer workflows to tailor solutions that meet their specific needs.

- Experience interpreting and applying API documentation.

- Experience with a range of API authentication methods including OAuth2 and JWT.

- Experience using and troubleshooting APIs to connect to a variety of security and/or IT tools.

- Passionate about supporting our customers and helping them automate their repetitive and manual workflows.

Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about.  At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

 The Opportunity 

 Join our engineering team in Bellevue building and enhancing Flexport’s client-facing rates platform and self-serve freight booking experience. You will work alongside experienced engineers and have direct ownership of features that move the company from an assisted-sales model to a tech-run one for the long tail of our client base.

 This team owns two of the highest-leverage surfaces in the Client App: how clients see pricing and how they book without manual intervention. Rates sit at the center of every freight decision, and you will build the systems that power rate visibility, quoting, and pricing intelligence across our ocean business. You will also help build the infrastructure that integrates AI-powered automation into the booking flow. This is a rare opportunity to build the "front door" of an $8.6 trillion industry, turning the complexity of global trade into a seamless digital experience for thousands of shippers.

 You Will 

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain systems within a microservices architecture that power rate visibility and autonomous booking.

- Own the entire lifecycle of a feature: from database schema design and scalable backend APIs to building the React-based frontend applications our customers use.

- Support the integration of AI models and automated workflows to make the pricing and booking experience increasingly intelligent.

- Collaborate with engineering, product, and design to translate complex business problems into elegant, production-ready technical solutions.

- Contribute to code reviews to maintain high quality standards, share knowledge, and mentor peer engineers.

- Build highly available, secure, and distributed systems that can scale with Flexport’s global volume.

- Rapidly build and launch products incrementally, leveraging best practices around CI/CD and shipping to production dozens of times per day.

- Ensure high-quality standards by incorporating metrics, monitoring, and applying learnings from post-mortems to all services.

 You Should Have 

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience with a proven track record of shipping production-grade applications.

- Full-Stack Capability: You are comfortable owning a feature from end-to-end: working with databases, backend services (Java/Ruby), and frontend frameworks (React).

- Technical Rigor: A passion for simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.

- AI Familiarity: Experience or interest in working with AI APIs and building software that leverages machine learning models to automate user tasks.

- 2+ years of design and architecture knowledge as well as familiarity with object-oriented analysis and design patterns.

- Proficiency with modern programming languages: specifically Java, Ruby, or TypeScript.

- Proficiency with deploying, monitoring, and maintaining production services on cloud infrastructure (AWS).

 It’s a Plus If You Have 

- Experience with elements of our tech stack: Java, Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, React, AWS.

- Experience in fintech, pricing engines, or booking systems.

- Experience in logistics, supply chain, or freight technology.

- A bias for action: When you see a problem, you fix it.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills: you can convey technical ideas in common terms to business stakeholders and product managers.

About the Team

As AI becomes capable of doing more useful work, the way people access and pay for it needs to evolve. Monetization Platform is a new team within Growth building the systems and experiences that make that possible across the entire suite of OpenAI products. Our mission is to make powerful AI easier to access, its value easier to understand, and new ways of using it easier to bring to market.

We work where product experience, platform architecture, and business strategy meet. A new plan or pricing model can change what customers can accomplish—and requires careful engineering across eligibility, entitlements, usage, and subscriptions. We turn that complexity into capabilities that product teams can build on and experiences that customers can trust.

Working with Product, Design, Finance, Financial Engineering, and Data Science, we’re shaping a platform that can evolve alongside our models and products. This is an opportunity to help define a new team’s technical direction and build systems that expand what OpenAI can offer.

 

About the Role

We’re looking for experienced Staff+ and Senior engineers who combine full-stack product instincts with strong backend and systems depth. You’ll help decide what to build, establish the architecture, and carry ideas through to working products—from a customer’s first interaction with a plan to the services that determine what they can access and use.

The work spans new pricing and packaging capabilities, plan and usage experiences, and the shared UIs and tools that make launches repeatable. You’ll partner closely with Financial Engineering to connect these capabilities to subscription and billing systems, keeping customer access and state consistent as offerings evolve.

You’ll have substantial ownership over technical decisions and delivery in an area where the roadmap is still taking shape. Your impact will show up in the experiences you ship, the engineering work you eliminate from future launches, and the opportunities your systems make possible.

 

In this role, you will:

 - Define and build shared pricing and packaging capabilities, including plan configuration, eligibility, entitlement integrations, and usage allowances.

 - Create intuitive plan and usage experiences across the stack, connecting polished interfaces to product APIs and backend services.

 - Turn new commercial ideas into working prototypes and experiments with Product, Finance, and Data Science, then use what you learn to guide the next iteration.

 - Design integrations with Financial Engineering that preserve correct access and subscription state through plan changes, migrations, asynchronous updates, and partial failures.

 - Build reusable components and configuration tools that let teams launch offerings with less custom engineering and fewer dependencies.

 - Take responsibility for production quality through migration planning, staged rollouts, testing, monitoring, and recovery paths.

 - Shape the technical roadmap, make clear tradeoffs between immediate launches and shared foundations, and develop other engineers through code and design reviews.

 

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have set architectural direction and delivered significant projects involving multiple teams, while remaining an active contributor to the code.

 - Bring depth in backend or distributed systems and can work across the APIs and interfaces that turn those systems into useful products.

 - Reason rigorously about data models, lifecycle transitions, consistency, concurrency, and what happens when an operation fails or runs twice.

 - Have taken loosely defined customer or business problems through discovery, implementation, and production operation.

 - Combine product intuition with experimentation and analysis, and care about whether customers understand and benefit from what you build.

 - Enjoy establishing new capabilities: choosing an initial design, shipping something useful, and improving it as the problem becomes clearer.

 - Build alignment across disciplines, explain technical choices clearly, and help teammates take on greater responsibility.

Experience with pricing, subscriptions, entitlements, usage-based products, billing integrations, or growth platforms would be especially valuable. We also welcome engineers whose experience building demanding product or platform systems prepares them to learn this domain.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

 Cloudflare's Developer Platform powers stateful, data-intensive applications across our network. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work across the database stack, from query planning and execution to transaction processing and durable storage.

 You'll make decisions that shape the consistency, durability, and latency guarantees that customer applications rely on.

 Correctness under concurrency and failure is central to the role. You'll define and implement how queries read and modify data, how concurrent transactions become visible, and how durable state is recovered. You'll validate these systems using deterministic simulation, workload testing, and evidence from production.

Responsibilities

- Improve query planning and execution, including index selection, row reads and writes, and performance as data volumes and access patterns change.

- Build transaction and storage paths that make writes durable and reads consistent. Define when changes become visible, how commits survive failure, and how recovery restores a correct view of the data.

- Design deterministic simulations that make rare event orderings and failures reproducible.

- Plan stateful upgrades that cannot be reversed by rolling back software. Carry them through staged rollout, failover, and recovery without putting existing data at risk.

- Participate in the service's on-call rotation and incident response.

- Own major changes from design through production. Coordinate implementation across teams when a change spans multiple parts of the service, and help trace failures across those parts.

- Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience

- You have owned a database, storage engine, transaction system, or similarly correctness-sensitive stateful system from architecture through production. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete.

- You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe.

- You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery. You can apply those concepts when operations arrive out of order, components fail independently, or the network partitions.

- You write and debug concurrent production software in Rust, Go, C++, or another systems language. You can trace failures across process, network, and durable-state boundaries.

- You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. You know the difference between transient unavailability and incomplete or incorrect recovery, and when a system is safe to return to service.

- You have led investigations where failures crossed systems owned by several teams.

Bonus Points

- You've worked on the internals of PostgreSQL, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, or another relational database and can trace a SQL operation from planning through commit.

- Your work on transaction processing or concurrency control has included defining snapshot visibility and recovery behavior.

- You've profiled database workloads and traced performance bottlenecks from query execution through durable storage.

- You've used deterministic simulation or another systematic method to uncover distributed-systems bugs that conventional tests missed.

A BOUT TIDE 

 At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

 Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

 Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

 Tide facts: 

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs

- Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing

- Over $300 million raised in funding

- 3,000 Tideans globally

- Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026

- We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Team

 The Data Platform Engineering team builds the platform that Tide's data producers and consumers rely on: backend engineers, data engineers, data scientists and, increasingly, AI agents. We own how data is produced, moved, stored, modelled, governed and served across the UK, EU and India, on GCP with BigQuery at the core.

 Our mission is to make the right way the easy way: self-service capabilities with quality, security and cost controls built into the infrastructure, judged by whether teams choose to adopt them, not whether we mandate them.

About The Role

 As Lead Engineer, Data Platform, you will be a hands-on individual contributor who leads platform initiatives within a clear technical direction set by the Data Infrastructure team. You will own small-medium platform initiatives and quarterly goals, taking them from design through to shipping and running them in production, and you will work closely with the Data Infrastructure Engineering Manager and the wider platform team.

In this role you will

- Design and deliver self-service paths so engineers can onboard new sources, datasets and pipelines without a ticket queue, with access, masking, quality and cost controls defined in infrastructure as code and CI/CD.

- Improve ingestion and transformation capabilities so data is fresher and more reliable, handling ordering, duplicates, late data, deletes, replay and backfill, and migrate pipelines without breaking downstream tables.

- Apply governance in what you build: residency, PII masking, least-privilege and just-in-time access, retention and erasure, and lineage.

- Set SLOs, freshness and quality checks, and alerting that tells on-call what matters.

- Find the main cost drivers in data platforms and pipelines, and add guardrails and attribution that teams can act on.

- Break work into phases that ship, with clear milestones, a migration path and a way to measure adoption.

- Use AI-assisted development to build and run the platform faster, and help prepare governed, well-described data that agents can use safely.

- Treat internal engineers as customers: write clear documentation and golden paths, and act on their feedback.

- Review designs and code for other engineers, and raise the bar for production-grade data and API work.

What We Are Looking For

 Tide is looking for a hands-on Lead Engineer to deliver platform initiatives end to end and raise the quality of our data platform. We value what you have shipped and operated over job titles or team size. The ideal candidate will have:

- Independently designed, shipped and operated a meaningful platform or data infrastructure initiative used by internal engineering teams.

- Solid data engineering fundamentals: batch and streaming ingestion, CDC and event-driven patterns, data modelling, and correctness (idempotency, ordering, late data, backfill).

- Strong production engineering in Python and SQL, including building and operating APIs, pipelines or shared libraries.

- Practical infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and CI/CD for data and infrastructure, including IAM across environments.

- Working knowledge of data governance in practice: PII masking, access control, residency, retention and lineage.

- Observability for data pipelines: freshness and quality checks, SLOs, alert thresholds and incident response.

- The ability to justify technology choices against requirements, with an order-of-magnitude view of cost and capacity.

- Hands-on use of AI-assisted development with sound engineering judgement. Experience enabling AI tooling for engineering teams is highly preferred.

- Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to explain trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers across teams and time zones.

- Nice to have: experience with global, decentralised teams, and in financial services or other regulated environments.

 You do not need to match every tool below. Comparable cloud and data tooling experience is welcome.

OUR TECH STACK

 Our data platform runs on GCP: BigQuery as our warehouse, Fivetran and event-driven ingestion, dbt, Apache Airflow (AWS MWAA), Looker, Atlan, Databricks, Terraform, GitHub, ConductorOne and Okta, Coralogix, and Claude for AI-assisted development. Our platform tooling is written mainly in Python, and our product teams build Java/Spring Boot services that publish events into the platform.

What You'll Get In Return

- Competitive Compensation – competitive salary

- Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.

- Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.

- Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options a

Role purpose
 You'll build cloud-native services and user interfaces for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a hands-on development role with a strong back-end focus. You'll design and build Java microservices and APIs on AWS, and also contribute to ReactJS/TypeScript front ends. You'll use AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Devin every day to deliver faster, while staying fully accountable for the quality and security of the code.

Key responsibilities
 Back-end development (primary) 
 
- Design and build Java/Spring Boot microservices and REST APIs for trade processing, accounting, reconciliation and settlement functions.

- Build event-driven integrations with Kafka and IBM MQ , including message design, error handling, retries and idempotency.

- Write efficient data access against Oracle (JPA/Hibernate and SQL), working with database engineers on schema design and performance.

- Rebuild legacy business logic as clean, testable services, working with business analysts and subject-matter experts to confirm behaviour.

- Write unit, integration and contract tests, and help with performance and resilience testing.
 AWS 
 
- Build and deploy services on AWS : ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS/SNS, RDS, CloudWatch and IAM.

- Design services for scalability, high availability and security, following AWS Well-Architected principles.

- Work with DevOps on Terraform, Docker and CI/CD pipelines (Harness/GitHub Actions) so your services deploy automatically.
 Front-end development (secondary) 
 
- Build and maintain ReactJS/TypeScript screens and components for data-heavy enterprise applications that replace legacy desktop UIs.

- Connect front ends to back-end APIs, handling authentication (SSO/MFA), state management and error handling.

- Write maintainable JavaScript/TypeScript and component tests (Jest/React Testing Library).
 AI-assisted development 
 
- Use GitHub Copilot for inline code completion, chat-based refactoring, test generation and pull-request summaries.

- Use Claude Code for agentic, multi-file work in the terminal: understanding unfamiliar codebases, refactoring across modules, generating tests and fixing failing builds.

- Work with Devin (or similar autonomous agents) on well-defined tasks: write clear task specs, review its pull requests and correct its output.

- Use AI to analyse legacy code (Java EE, Sybase SQL, PowerBuilder, COBOL) and draft specs for subject-matter experts to confirm.

- Write good prompts and context files (e.g. README files, coding standards, agent instruction files) so AI tools produce code that follows team standards.

- Review all AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance and licence compliance before merging. You stay accountable for every line.

- Share effective prompts, patterns and lessons learned with the team.

- Take part in code reviews, design discussions and agile ceremonies.

- Support production releases, cutovers and early-life support, and fix issues quickly.

- Follow State Street secure coding, information security, data classification and approved-AI-tool policies.

- 6+ years in software development, mostly on the back end.

- Java: strong in Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Data/JPA, REST API design and multithreading.

- AWS: good hands-on knowledge of core services (ECS/EKS or Lambda, S3, SQS/SNS, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch).

- Databases: strong SQL; experience with Oracle or another enterprise relational database.

- ReactJS/TypeScript/JavaScript: good working knowledge of React hooks, component design, TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+).

- AI tools: proven, regular use of at least one of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or Devin in professional delivery, including the ability to judge when AI output is wrong.

- Engineering practices: Git, CI/CD, Docker, automated testing (JUnit, Mockito) and clean code principles.

- Experience working in agile delivery teams.
 
Preferred
 
- Hands-on experience with all three of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Devin, and a view on which tool suits which task.

- Experience with MCP servers or giving AI agents context from Jira, Confluence or code repositories.

- Experience in financial services, ideally investment servicing or middle-office areas (trade lifecycle, settlement, collateral, reconciliation or accounting).

- Experience modernizing legacy applications (e.g. Java EE/EJB on Payara or WebSphere, Sybase).

- Experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code.

- AWS Developer Associate or Solutions Architect certification.
 
Success measures (first 12 months)
 
- Delivered production-ready services and front-end features for modernized applications, on schedule.

- Services meet agreed standards for test coverage, performance, security and observability.

- Measurable productivity gains from AI tools (e.g. cycle time, test coverage), with no rise in defects or rework.

- Contributed reusable prompts, agent instructions or patterns that the wider team uses.

- Became a trusted contributor in design and code reviews across the team.

jobs.jd:
BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $169 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a curious, hands-on security professional early in their career to join our Detection & Response team as an Incident Response Developer. You’ll report to the Manager of Detection & Response and work closely with senior responders to investigate security incidents, improve our response processes and build automation that helps us scale. You’ll get hands-on experience with real incidents and the mentorship to grow into the craft.



The ideal candidate has a foundation in security fundamentals, some hands-on exposure to investigations or security operations, and real enthusiasm for automating repetitive work. You’re a problem-solver who stays calm when things get busy, asks good questions and wants to learn from experienced teammates.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Strengthen our incident response capabilities by building relationships with Engineering teams, writing new playbooks and automating manual steps.

 - Own investigations from start to finish: triage, evidence collection, analysis, containment and documentation.

 - Act as Incident Commander for low- and medium-severity incidents, and support senior responders on high-severity ones.

 - Turn recurring incident types into repeatable workflows (intake, playbook, automation, closure), from the first design through to the tooling behind them.

 - Report incident trends and metrics that inform team priorities.

 - Work with our Security Engineers to monitor, refine and expand our SIEM and SOAR platforms.

 - Work with the HR, Fraud and Privacy teams on investigations into potentially fraudulent and sensitive activity, including insider threats and snooping.

 - Participate in an on-call rotation for responding to security incidents, internal questions and operational support.

 - Work with the detection engineering team to develop new, high-fidelity detection rules based on incident trends and threat intelligence.




SKILLS YOU BRING

 - 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity.

 - 1–2+ years of hands-on incident response experience, owning investigations end to end.

 - The ability to coordinate responders and stakeholders during an incident, and know when to escalate.

 - Experience using a SIEM to turn noise into signal, including writing queries and tuning alerts.

 - Proficiency with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.) to build and maintain automation. We invest in tooling (automation, Slack bots, AI agents) so responders spend their energy on the decisions that matter.

 - A workflow mindset: you can look at a messy, recurring problem and break it into steps that tooling or AI can take on.

 - Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP or Azure) and how to investigate within it.

 - Discretion and sound judgment when handling sensitive information, such as HR and insider-threat matters.

 - Clear, honest and inclusive communication with both internal and external stakeholders.

 - Good judgment under pressure, in technical problem solving and in working across teams.

 - A strong desire to learn from the team and others. We value making one another successful!




WHY WEALTHSIMPLE?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles. 




ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.

 As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer on our Bengaluru/India team, you will be the senior-most technical voice on the ground — setting architectural direction for our Kubernetes platform, driving the hardest reliability and scaling problems to resolution, and partnering with Staff/Principal engineers on our US and India teams to keep our global platform strategy coherent. You'll report to the Manager, Site Reliability Engineering, and work closely with the rest of the India SRE team, as well as global SRE peers.

 What you'll be doing: 

- Owning the architecture and evolution of our Kubernetes platform for the Bengaluru/India team — cluster strategy, multi-tenancy, networking, and security posture — in close coordination with counterparts in the US and India

- Leading the technical design and rollout of self-service platform capabilities, golden paths, and self-healing patterns that let internal teams ship and operate workflows without deep platform expertise

- Driving the platform's readiness to host AI-driven internal workflows reliably at scale — model serving, GPU scheduling, and orchestration infrastructure

- Taking ownership of the hardest, highest-ambiguity reliability problems: complex production incidents, capacity and scaling challenges, and cross-system failure modes

- Participating in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation shared with SRE peers in the US and India, and driving root-cause resolution and postmortems for the incidents you own

- Setting technical standards for SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, and on-call practice, and holding the team accountable to them

- Improving SDLC processes for infrastructure-as-code, including CI/CD pipeline maturity and change/release management

- Mentoring engineers across the team and raising the technical bar through design reviews, architecture discussions, and hands-on pairing

- Partnering with architects, security, and product engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with the business's reliability, security, and delivery needs

- Representing the Bengaluru/India team in global platform architecture discussions, working as a peer with Staff/Principal-level engineers in the US and India

 What you'll bring to the role: 

- 8+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering, with a track record of staff-level technical leadership

- Deep, hands-on expertise in Kubernetes at production scale — architecture, multi-tenancy, networking, security, and day-2 operations

- Experience running large-scale internal infrastructure platforms in a public cloud, preferably AWS

- Strong expertise in cloud-native architectures, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), and CI/CD pipelines (Github Actions)

- Strong proficiency in Python or similar scripting and programming languages.

- Experience building or operating infrastructure that hosts AI/ML or agentic workflows — model serving, GPU scheduling, or orchestration frameworks

- Deep experience with observability platforms and monitoring tools (Grafana, Splunk, APM, or equivalent) in a large-scale environment

- Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams and geographies without formal authority

- Effective verbal and written communication skills, with experience mentoring engineers and driving technical alignment across distributed teams

- Computer Science degree or related field, or equivalent experience

This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck — that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window.

- CI/CD Pipeline Architecture — Hub Standard: Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado — defining the standard pipeline stages (develop → validate → test → UAT → staging → production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release.

- Secrets & Credential Management: Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments — including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management.

 PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 
 
 We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
 
 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 
 
 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

 Job Summary: 
The Offensive Security team helps protect PayPal and its brands by testing products, applications, networks, cloud environments, infrastructure, and emerging technologies. We work closely with engineering and infrastructure teams to identify security issues, explain the risk, and support effective remediation.

This role combines hands-on penetration testing with vulnerability validation across application, network, and cloud environments. You will review findings from AI assisted code reviews and other automated security tools, reproduce potential vulnerabilities, and assess their exploitability and business impact. You will also perform targeted manual testing and secure code reviews to identify complex issues, including business logic weaknesses that automated tools may not fully understand.

 Essential Responsibilities: 

- Independently apply security best practices to enhance and optimize systems, ensuring robust protection and efficiency, while beginning to understand and align security solutions with business objectives.

- Partner with peers and internal teams to drive security initiatives, contribute to cross-functional projects, and at times co-lead efforts to strengthen security posture.

- Analyze and resolve security challenges by adapting standard processes and exploring alternative approaches to address complex threats.

- Influence the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the team through informed decision-making, with a potential impact on other teams.

- Collaborate with other engineers to gather and incorporate feedback, driving continuous improvements in security processes.

 Minimum Qualifications: 

- 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

 Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : 

 The Offensive Security team works with groups across PayPal to assess the security of products, networks, and technologies throughout the product development life cycle. The team performs authorized testing across web, mobile, API, thick client, network, cloud, infrastructure, and other technology environments.
 
 The successful candidate will be comfortable working with product, infrastructure, and engineering teams and will provide clear technical context, reproduction steps, realistic attack scenarios, and practical remediation guidance.
 
 In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for: 
 
- Scope and perform penetration tests from planning through reporting and remediation support.

- Perform hands-on testing of web applications, mobile applications, APIs, and internal infrastructure.

- Perform network penetration testing and segmentation testing across internal, external, and cloud network environments.
