About Anthropic 

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

 The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) manages the devices Anthropic’s people work on, plus the infrastructure underneath them. We treat the fleet as a distributed platform, not a collection of devices, and configuration ships as code through pull requests, CI, staging, and a canary group. Today the fleet is mostly macOS, with a growing mobile footprint.

 Anthropic also works with vendor and business process outsourcing (BPO) partners whose teams need access to Anthropic systems. Those programs are growing, in more countries and with more vendors. Anthropic-owned Chromebooks issued to vendor staff are becoming the default device for vendor teams. This role exists to make ChromeOS a supported platform with a dedicated owner. You will own ChromeOS end to end, from how devices are bought and enrolled to how they are locked down, monitored, and retired, and help bring Android in as a second platform.

 The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You’ll define what ChromeOS looks like at Anthropic and own the platform decisions that get it there.

Responsibilities

- Own ChromeOS as a platform at Anthropic: device standards, Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise setup, organizational unit design, and policy

- Manage ChromeOS policy as code through the Chrome Policy API, GAM, and Terraform, in the team's config-as-code pipeline, so changes are reviewed, tested, and progressively rolled out like the rest of the fleet

- Build zero touch enrollment through resellers, so a Chromebook arrives enrolled and works the first time in every country our vendor partners work from

- Work with IT Operations and procurement partners on buying and shipping devices internationally, including regions our current partners don’t reach

- Design device models for vendor teams (kiosk, managed guest sessions, shared devices, and assigned devices) and pick the right one for each program

- Lock devices down to what the work needs: copy and paste, downloads, printing, USB, and app and extension controls

- Own the device lifecycle for vendor fleets, from enrollment to wipe, lock, and retrieval when an engagement ends

- Feed ChromeOS device data into our fleet telemetry, tracking which devices are checking in, OS version, and drift between expected and actual state

- Partner with Corporate Security on hardware standards (such as Verified Access attestation and minimum AUE date), device trust signals, and access decisions

- Work with Security on the contractor access model and on keeping Anthropic data off vendor devices

- Run data loss controls through Chrome Enterprise Premium

- Work with Security on the vendor identity model: which accounts vendor staff use and in which tenant

- Support Android as a second platform, working with the corporate mobile program on Android Enterprise and zero-touch enrollment

- Write the runbooks IT Operations and vendor partners use to stand up a new program

You may be a good fit if you

- Have owned ChromeOS as a platform for a fleet of thousands of devices

- Know the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise well: OU design, device and user policy, enrollment, and reporting

- Have automated ChromeOS policy through the Chrome Policy API or GAM

- Have run kiosk, managed guest, or shared device programs for frontline, contact center, or outsourced teams

- Have set up zero touch enrollment with resellers and shipped devices across several countries

- Have worked with Android device management and can hold your own in a mixed fleet

- Excel at ambiguous problems that touch several teams at once

- Communicate technical concepts clearly to any audience, including vendor partners

- View IT Engineering as requiring product engineering rigor

- Write clear documentation as a natural part of your workflow

- Manage device configuration as code (pull requests, CI, staged rollout) instead of clicking in consoles

- Have managed ChromeOS alongside macOS or mobile fleets

- Have used VDI or browser-based access to keep data off the device for outsourced teams

- Have supported BPO or vendor programs through fast growth into new regions

- Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry

- Have used LLMs to automate operational work, or are excited to make Claude a teammate

Technical Skills

- Python and shell scripting

- ChromeOS management through the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise

jobs.jd:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


ABOUT SNOWFLAKE

Snowflake is building the AI Data Cloud, enabling organizations around the world to mobilize data and develop applications at global scale. The Engineering Systems organization builds the infrastructure, tools, and platforms that help Snowflake engineers develop, test, and deliver high-quality software efficiently.

The Continuous Integration team is responsible for the systems that power builds, tests, validation, and developer workflows across Snowflake’s engineering organization. As a Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will help define the technical direction of critical CI infrastructure used by thousands of engineers across a rapidly growing, multi-cloud codebase.


AS A STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL

 - Own the technical direction and architecture of large-scale Continuous Integration services and infrastructure.

 - Design, build, and operate distributed systems that support reliable, performant, and secure software delivery.

 - Lead the development of CI capabilities that improve build reliability, test execution, developer productivity, and release velocity.

 - Partner with engineering leadership, product managers, and teams across Snowflake to define quarterly and long-term technical roadmaps.

 - Drive architectural decisions across build systems, test orchestration, resource scheduling, workflow execution, and developer tooling.

 - Identify systemic bottlenecks in the software delivery lifecycle and develop solutions that improve engineering efficiency at scale.

 - Establish high standards for design, code quality, testing, observability, reliability, and operational readiness.

 - Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative problem-solving.

 - Lead complex projects involving multiple teams and cross-functional dependencies.

 - Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements.

 - Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices to keep Snowflake’s developer platform scalable and effective.


OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE

 - 7+ years of industry experience designing and building production software systems.

 - A track record of technical leadership across complex, multi-team engineering initiatives.

 - Deep experience designing and operating distributed systems at scale.

 - Experience building or significantly evolving enterprise-grade Continuous Integration or Continuous Delivery systems.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and systems design.

 - Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, C++, Python, or Go.

 - Experience making architectural decisions involving scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.

 - A strong understanding of developer productivity and the software development lifecycle.

 - Excellent problem-solving skills and sound technical judgment.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.

 - A collaborative mindset and a demonstrated ability to mentor and influence engineers across teams.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with CI/CD and build systems such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bazel, ArgoCD, or comparable platforms.

 - Experience with build optimization, caching, parallel execution, incremental builds, or distributed test scheduling.

 - Experience designing multi-tenant systems with strong isolation, reliability, performance, and security requirements.

 - Experience with Kubernetes, containers, or public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

 - Experience operating large-scale developer platforms or engineering infrastructure.

 - Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, and production operations.

 - Experience authoring technical roadmaps, architecture documents, project plans, postmortems, and root-cause analyses.

 - Experience working with data systems, distributed storage, or cloud-based services.

 - A history of improving engineering practices and multiplying the effectiveness of teams.


WHY ENGINEERING SYSTEMS AT SNOWFLAKE?

 - Build infrastructure that thousands of Snowflake engineers rely on every day.

 - Solve challenging distributed systems and developer productivity problems at significant scale.

 - Help improve the speed, reliability, and quality of software delivery across Snowflake.

 - Work with experienced engineers across a multi-cloud data platform.

 - Influence the technical direction of critical engineering infrastructure.

 - Grow your impact through architecture, mentorship, and cross-team technical leadership.

Snowflake is committed to pay equity and transparency. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

About Thunes: 

 Thunes is the Smart Superhighway to move money around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets, stablecoin wallets and bank accounts worldwide, as well as 15 billion cards via more than 220 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

 Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house SmartX Treasury System and Fortress Compliance Platform, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivaled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments, globally.

 Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

 Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 14 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, Hong Kong, Johannesburg, London, Manila, Nairobi, New York, Paris, Riyadh, San Francisco and Shanghai. For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/ 

 Context of the role 

 We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Golang) who is passionate about the FinTech industry, wants to work in a disruptive, fast-growing and exciting environment. As part of the Engineering team, based in Europe, this role will bring you great opportunities to work on various projects, technologies, with a diverse range of teams.

 The Engineering team is responsible for developing our core business products and getting them to production in the most efficient and fastest way possible. We architect solutions, tools and platforms to solve business needs and tools around provisioning, configuration, CICD, monitoring, SLA, performance and uptime. Our team is passionate about the details and we work very closely with a wide range of stakeholders. Processing millions of transactions per month and interconnecting hundreds of partners from all around the world, Thunes is continuously growing its coverage and footprint in the industry.

 Responsibilities 

 We’re looking for a highly driven, self-motivated, technically excellent engineer who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company and payments industry. In this role, you will combine a startup mindset with the scale of an industry leader. Working on our core platform and services you will help us to create the future of the company, by ensuring the scalability and performance of the platform, delivering new functionalities, automating and improving development processes.

- Work on highly available services, exposed mainly by APIs

- Participate in the design, implementation and shipping of new products to internal and external stakeholders

- Deliver high quality, testable, secure, readable, scalable and documented software

- Understand, apply and champion the principles of the agile methodology (code reviews, sprint planning, pair programming, daily stand-ups, etc..)

- Assist in the evaluation of new technologies and initiatives 

 What we are looking for 

- Preferably a degree in Information Technology, Engineering Computer Science or related fields

- Software engineers that are motivated, curious and have an appetite for learning

- Proficient in Golang

- Experience with Event-Driven Architecture and message brokers (e.g., AWS SNS/SQS, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ)

- Experience with relational databases (e.g, PostgreSQL, MySQL)

- Passionate about Agile Methodology and practices (TDD, CI, CD, etc..)

- Experience designing and developing web and API solutions

- Interest in the Fintech Industry and market innovations

 Benefits 

- Great compensation package, including performance & company bonus

- Private Health insurance for you and your family

- Life Insurance

- Work life balance (flexibility and hybrid working policy)

- Great offices close to Sagrada Familia

- Learning & Development budget

- Our team is global, you will work with 40+ different nationalities spread across 5 continents

- 25 days of holidays + 2 Thunes Out Days + 2 Community days

 We can offer you an environment where we have a culture of learning and feedback. You will be challenged to own your code - write, test, deploy it, multiple times per day. Our technology is used 24/7 and around the world, it needs to be reliable, secure and massively scalable. You will also need to interface with technology teams in different countries. Our environment and packages match the ambition of the company - building world class engineering teams. 

 Sound like you? Apply now!
